raw.description:
Who we are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What you will do

The Investigator Grants Specialist is responsible for the development and dissemination of Investigator Grants (pre and post-award) while supporting various groups related to Investigator Grants delivery.

Reports directly to the Investigator Grants Manager.
Responsible for the development, delivery and maintenance of Investigator Grants exports during the bidding phase and during the template development phase of a study
Works closely with appropriate teams to ensure accurate, complete and timely deliveries of Investigator Grants.
Assists in the development and maintenance of processes, policies, SOPs and associated documents concerning Investigator Grants.
Liaises with the Investigator Grants team and advises Commercial Operations, Project Management, Business Development, Site Activation, Clinical Operations and Customers on forecasting strategies/risk mitigation surrounding Investigator Grants.
Review study protocols and liaise with competent departments as needed to complete a costing strategy for protocol-driven costs.
Review study budgets and costs pertaining to Investigator Grants operations and participate in Commercial Operations activities.

Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive.

What you will bring to the role

Knowledge regarding global industry standard benchmarks, fair market value, and proven expertise using investigator grant software (i.e., GrantPlan, Grants Manager) on a global level.
Experience in reviewing and understanding study protocols, study budgets, as well as other technical, medical and legal documents related to Investigator Grants.
Ability to work in fast-paced, deadline oriented, and changing environment
Strong planning, strategizing, managing, monitoring, scheduling, critiquing and problem solving skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including negotiation skills and knowledge of clinical trial agreements to clearly and concisely present information.
Computer expertise with document and spreadsheet applications.

Your experience

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business administration, law, science or related field.
Minimum of 2 years of experience in forecasting Investigator Grants.
Adept knowledge of biopharmaceutical/CRO industry and applicable local regulatory requirements.
Knowledge and understanding of global industry standard benchmarks, fair market value, ICH and GCP Guidelines, as well as local compensation and regulatory requirements.
Excellent spoken and written English language skills.
Prefer experience with investigator grant forecasting tools (i.e. GrantPlan, Grants Manager)

Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently.

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide! For more information on Worldwide, visit or connect with us on LinkedIn.

Worldwide is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed and, to that end, we prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and creativity. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative, and successful. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, military status, or other class protected by applicable law.

raw.title: Therapeutic Account Manager, Liver - Pittsburgh
raw.excerpt: MISSIONMirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases.
raw.description:
MISSION

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.

The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.

JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES

Territory Strategy & Business Performance

  • Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
  • Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
  • Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
  • Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.

Strategic Account Management & Network Development

  • Identify, prioritize, and develop high-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
  • Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
  • Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow-through.
  • Map influence and decision-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
  • Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.

Clinical Aptitude & Customer Engagement

  • Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
  • Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
  • Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
  • Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.

Influence & Impact

  • Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
  • Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
  • Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries

Customer, Patient & Caregiver Impact

  • Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
  • Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.
  • Collaborate compliantly with Market Access and Patient Services partners to help care teams understand available resources and navigate appropriate barriers in the patient journey.
  • Identify recurring customer, access, and patient-support barriers; elevate them objectively and promptly; and partner with the appropriate internal teams to improve execution and support.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Insights

  • Build productive partnerships with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, Analytics, and Advocacy.
  • Work seamlessly across field roles to coordinate account strategy, align priorities, clarify responsibilities, and ensure consistent follow-through while respecting functional boundaries.
  • Capture and communicate timely, objective, and actionable field insights that can inform strategy, messaging, training, resource development, customer experience, and execution priorities.
  • Contribute actively to business reviews, training programs, team meetings, launch readiness, and cross-functional initiatives; share best practices and support the success of the broader organization.

Entrepreneurial Drive, Resilience & Culture

  • Operate with a high degree of ownership, self-motivation, resourcefulness, and initiative in an unstructured, rapidly evolving rare disease environment.
  • Create appropriate engagement opportunities in underdeveloped accounts and markets, test new approaches, learn quickly, and translate insights into action.
  • Maintain sustained drive, discipline, and performance through pressure, uncertainty, obstacles, delays, and discouragement; recover quickly and remain focused on long-term goals.
  • Demonstrate curiosity, coachability, and a commitment to continuous learning; actively seek feedback and apply coaching to strengthen clinical, strategic, and selling capabilities.
  • Model Mirum's values and the highest standards of ethical conduct, compliance, transparency, inclusion, and respect in every internal and external interaction.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of progressive sales experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Demonstrated track record of consistently delivering business results in a complex specialty, rare disease, orphan drug, or high-science market.
  • Rare disease experience is highly preferred; experience in hepatology, gastroenterology, pediatric specialty care, or another complex specialty market is highly desirable.
  • Strong clinical aptitude and demonstrated ability to learn, retain, and communicate complex disease-state, diagnostic, mechanism-of-action, clinical-data, and product information.
  • Experience with account-based selling across health systems, centers of excellence, multidisciplinary care teams, referral networks, and influential healthcare professionals.
  • Demonstrated ability to use insight-led or challenger-style selling to constructively challenge the status quo, influence behavior, and advance customer decision-making.
  • Working knowledge of access and reimbursement dynamics, patient support pathways, and the role of patient services in rare disease markets.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to interpret performance data, identify insights, develop territory and account strategies, and translate plans into consistent field execution.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence, communication, presentation, judgment, and ability to build trust with diverse and highly sophisticated customers.
  • Proven self-motivation, resourcefulness, resilience, organization, and ability to prioritize and perform independently in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
  • Demonstrated success partnering cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, and Analytics.
  • Commitment to ethical conduct, compliance, and approved promotional practices, with sound judgment in complex customer and patient-related situations.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel up to 70%, including frequent overnight travel and occasional weekend commitments.

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all Federal, State and Local laws that prohibit employment discrimination on the basis of race, age, national origin, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship, genetic disposition or characteristics, disability, veteran’s status or any other classification protected by applicable State/Federal/Local laws.

Mirum Pharmaceuticals provides reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in job application procedures.

COMPANY OVERVIEW:

Unison is a leading telecom and renewables infrastructure investment firm founded in 2003 that has successfully invested more than $2 billion in acquiring assets in the U.S. and Europe. Since 2021, we have been in partnership with Ardian, the global investment house with over $150 billion in assets under management. Unison continues to expand rapidly and is looking for talented, entrepreneurial people to grow with us.

The Job

  • Support team members to develop and maintain an individual customer pipeline in line with the company’s model.
  • Own and manage your personal origination pipeline using curated data from initial engagement through executed closing.
  • Serve as the primary advisor to prospective clients, building relationships and guiding them through the ground lease buyout process.
  • Evaluate opportunities and structure preliminary terms directly with property owners.
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management to achieve defined monthly, quarterly, and annual origination targets.
  • Contribute to strategic initiatives and product innovation to strengthen our competitive position.
  • Develop deep expertise in the telecommunications and infrastructure investment industries.

Attributes

  • A successful candidate will bring a high level of ethical, intellectual, professional, and personal values that complement the team and company culture, including:
  • A love of competition.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven ability to deliver results and prioritize tasks in a fast-moving, dynamic environment.
  • Outstanding negotiation and influence skills.
  • Respect for colleagues and sense of humor.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university required or 4+ years of work experience in business to consumer (B2C) sales.
  • Natural sales talent with strong business acumen.
  • Exceptional negotiation skills.
  • Experience negotiating transactions from sourcing through close.
  • Familiarity with real estate closing processes.
  • Familiarity with finance concepts such as IRR and NPV.
  • Experience originating or developing within renewable energy, commercial real estate, mortgages, telecom, land acquisition, mineral rights acquisition.

Ferguson has approximately 36,000 associates across 1,700 locations. Ferguson is a community of proud associates who operate with the shared purpose of building something meaningful. Senior Lease Administrator -Corporate Real Estate & Facilities

Location: This is approved to be Remote from anywhere in the US or will be hybrid if you live in the Newport News, VA HQ area, per Company Policy.

Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Maintain and update lease records, including lease abstracts, critical dates, and payment schedules, ensuring data accuracy and compliance.

raw.title: Trust & Compliance Operations Manager
raw.excerpt: THE OPPORTUNITYJoin a team that’s changing financial services Zocks is the #1 AI assistant for financial advisors.
raw.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

Join a team that’s changing financial services

Zocks is the #1 AI assistant for financial advisors. We help advisors automate their operational work and grow their business. 5,000+ firms use Zocks to turn client conversations into completed work.

We're a venture-backed team, building something that changes how financial advisors serve their clients every day. Every role here is an opportunity to shape the product, the company, and the way an entire industry works. We hire sharp, curious, and kind people who want to do meaningful work and build something from the ground up, together.


WHO YOU ARE

The SHARC in the room

At Zocks, we hire for SHARC - five qualities that define how our best people work and win together.

S - Sharp

You move fast without cutting corners. Quick decisions, thoughtful execution - you know when to act independently and when to loop in leadership.

H - Hungry

You're a self-starter who celebrates teammates as loudly as your own wins. Humble hustle is your default mode.

A - Adaptable

Startup life means things shift fast. You lean into change, pivot gracefully, and genuinely enjoy figuring out what's next.

R - Resilient

Building something new isn't always smooth. You bounce back stronger, see obstacles as puzzles, and never lose sight of the bigger picture.

C - Curious

You ask the questions others miss. You explore for fun, not just for work - and it shows in the quality of your thinking.

About the Role

Zocks sells into compliance-sensitive financial services buyers - RIAs, IBDs, and wealth management firms - who put every vendor through security and compliance diligence before signing. Today, that diligence work falls on individual AEs, who complete VDDQs, RFPs, and RFIs themselves on top of their deal work, with no single owner, no shared knowledge base, and no visibility into how much it's costing the business in cycle time.

The Trust & Compliance Operations Manager owns this function end to end - the data room, the trust center, the VDDQ/RFP response process - turning diligence from a deal-blocking bottleneck reps absorb into a well-run, self-service function that shortens sales cycles and reinforces trust with our buyers, pre- and post-sale.

What You’ll Do

1. VDDQ, RFP, and RFI Ownership

  • Serve as the single point of accountability for every vendor due diligence questionnaire, RFP, and RFI that touches a deal - new business, renewal, or expansion.
  • Take response ownership off individual AEs entirely, running intake, drafting, internal review, and submission as a repeatable process.
  • Track every open request to a defined SLA and flag at-risk deals to Sales leadership before they slip.

2. Knowledge Base and Trust Center

  • Build and maintain a living knowledge base of pre-approved, audit-ready answers to recurring security, privacy, and compliance questions.
  • Keep that knowledge base current with each SOC 2 cycle, policy update, or material product/infrastructure change.
  • Partner with Engineering to scope and launch a self-service trust center when the knowledge base and process are mature enough to support it.

3. Data Room Management

  • Own the structure and upkeep of the due diligence data room - taxonomy, document versioning, access controls, and what's customer-facing versus internal.
  • Ensure every document in the room reflects the current state of Zocks' security and compliance posture, not a stale snapshot from the last deal.

4. Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Act as the connective tissue between Security, Legal, and Product on one side and Sales/CS on the other, so sales teams get accurate, current information without chasing multiple internal owners.
  • Build direct relationships with subject-matter owners in each function to keep source information flowing without manual chasing on every request.

5. Reporting and Commercial Impact

  • Define and publish an SLA for DDQ/RFP turnaround, and hold the function to it.
  • Report quarterly on deals unblocked or accelerated by the function, quantified in $ ARR, so leadership can see the direct commercial value of the work.

What We’re Looking For

Requirements

  • 4+ years experience owning VDDQs/RFPs/RFIs end to end, ideally in a regulated B2B SaaS environment
  • Working knowledge of security, privacy, and compliance frameworks relevant to financial-services vendors - SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, GLBA/Reg S-P, and SEC/FINRA vendor oversight expectations
  • Demonstrated ability to translate technical and legal detail into plain-English, customer-ready language under deadline pressure
  • Experience building repeatable process and structure (data room taxonomy, knowledge base, SLAs) rather than handling diligence as one-off firefighting
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with Security, Legal, Engineering, and Product to source accurate answers without deep technical expertise in each domain
  • Experience operating directly with prospects' and customers' security, compliance, and vendor-management teams, including on live diligence calls
  • Experience in or selling to financial services, wealthtech, or another regulated industry strongly preferred, given Zocks' focus on financial advisors and wealth management firms
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

LOGISTICS

  • This is a remote position, but we are currently only able to hire candidates who reside in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, ID, IL, IA, KS, MA, MI, NE, NJ, NV, NY, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, WA, WI
  • Background and reference checks required as part of onboarding

Interview process:

  • 30-min recruiter screen
  • Up to three 30-45-min video or onsite interviews
  • Offer pending references.

Total estimated time: ~3 hours

COMPENSATION

  • $150,000-$175,000 base salary
  • Equity - we're all building this together

BENEFITS

The full picture

Health

  • Medical: 100% of employee premium covered (UnitedHealthcare Select Plus network, 2 plan options)
  • Dental: 99% covered - Guardian, $1,500 annual benefit
  • Vision: 99% covered - Guardian/VSP, $150 frames & contacts allowance
  • FSA: Zocks matches dollar-for-dollar up to $500/year

Time off

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid sick time
  • 11 paid holidays

Family

  • Birthing parent: 12 weeks fully paid parental leave
  • Non-birthing parent: 6 weeks fully paid parental leave

Financial

  • 401(k) via Guideline - Pre-tax and Roth options; low-cost Vanguard funds

Everything else

  • MacBook laptop + Google Workspace, Slack, and Zoom provided
  • Equity grant - details included as part of your offer
  • Growth opportunities for high performers after 6 months
  • Collaborative, low-ego culture with smart, kind teammates

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Zocks AI is an equal opportunity employer. We never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status. We believe diversity drives creativity, innovation, and success - and we encourage all qualified people to apply.

We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process. These tools assist our team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are always made by humans.

Description

About Us:

At Vertu Agent, we are a high-performance, client-focused firm operating across several industries. We combine innovation, professionalism, and collaboration to deliver exceptional service. Our teams are empowered with the resources, training, and autonomy to exceed client expectations while growing professionally.

Our Culture:

We prioritize excellence, accountability, and continuous learning. Our environment is collaborative yet results-driven, celebrating initiative, problem-solving, and high-impact contributions. Top performers are recognized, mentored, and given opportunities to take on leadership responsibilities.

About the Role

This is not a traditional Executive Assistant or Virtual Assistant position. We are looking for someone who can become a trusted operational right hand to the founder—someone who can take an idea or objective, determine what needs to happen next, and help turn it into execution.

AI proficiency is a key component of this role. The ideal candidate actively uses tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms to research, solve problems, organize information, improve processes, and execute work more efficiently.

You will work across three different business ventures and support a wide variety of initiatives. Because the projects can change frequently, we need someone who is highly adaptable, intellectually curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out without step-by-step instructions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide high-level executive and operational support to the founder across multiple businesses and projects.
  • Turn broad ideas, objectives, and requests into clear action plans and next steps.
  • Use AI tools extensively for research, problem-solving, planning, documentation, content development, and workflow optimization.
  • Research unfamiliar topics independently and identify practical solutions, resources, and approaches.
  • Manage and coordinate multiple projects simultaneously, keeping priorities, deadlines, and follow-ups organized.
  • Support new business initiatives, digital projects, email campaigns, research, and other special projects.
  • Assist with operational, administrative, and financial coordination as needed.
  • Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, or improve existing workflows.
  • Coordinate with external vendors, contractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders.
  • Maintain clear documentation and track important decisions, deliverables, and action items.
  • Anticipate potential problems or bottlenecks and proactively recommend solutions.
  • Evaluate different approaches and confidently suggest alternatives when there is a better or more efficient way to accomplish an objective.
  • Take ownership of assignments from initial research through execution and follow-up.

Requirements

  • Previous experience in Executive Assistance, Operations, Project Coordination, Founder Support, or a similar role.
  • Experience working directly with a founder, CEO, entrepreneur, or senior executive is strongly preferred.
  • Strong practical proficiency with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to demonstrate how you have used AI to solve problems, improve workflows, conduct research, or increase productivity.
  • Excellent problem-solving and research abilities.
  • Strong initiative and ability to work independently with limited supervision.
  • Ability to receive an ambiguous objective and independently determine the appropriate next steps.
  • Excellent organizational and project-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities at the same time.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (C1,C2)
  • Strong technological aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through.
  • Comfortable questioning assumptions, sharing ideas, and recommending better approaches rather than simply following instructions.
  • A strong sense of ownership, accountability, and work ethic.

Compensation

$1,200 - $1,400 per month

Benefits

  • 10 days of per month
  • 3 sick days
  • 6 US Federal Holidays

  • Apoiar implementação e manutenção de catálogos de dados, metadata e data registries;
  • Garantir conformidade com regulamentações e frameworks de governance;
  • Promover qualidade, consistência e accountability dos dados;
  • Contribuir para estratégias de governance aplicadas a soluções AI/ML e uso responsável de dados.

  • Experiência comprovada na colaboração com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio;
  • Experiência na documentação de políticas, schemas e processos utilizando ferramentas como Confluence, Notion ou Miro;
  • Conhecimentos de plataformas ITSM e workflow management (ServiceNow ou Jira);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de data registry e data management (Airtable ou similares);
  • Familiaridade com frameworks regulatórios e de governance (GDPR, NIST, ISO 42001);
  • Conhecimentos de plataformas de data catalog e metadata management;

  • Experiência com frameworks de governance aplicados a AI/ML e Responsible AI;
  • Familiaridade com plataformas modernas de dados e ecossistemas cloud;
  • Experiência em iniciativas de transformação enterprise relacionadas com governance;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e orientação para melhoria contínua.

O que Oferecemos

  • Participação em projetos estratégicos de Data Governance e transformação digital;
  • Integração numa equipa colaborativa e orientada à excelência;

  • Oportunidades de crescimento técnico e evolução profissional;
  • Contacto com ecossistemas modernos de dados e AI governance;
  • Pacote salarial competitivo, ajustado à experiência.

Queres liderar iniciativas de governação de dados e contribuir para uma cultura orientada à qualidade e confiança da informação?

Junta-te a nós e ajuda a construir práticas de Data Governance modernas, escaláveis e preparadas para o futuro.

Our client, a fast-growing DTC footwear brand focused on minimalist and barefoot shoes, is searching for an experienced Supply Chain Manager for a full-time remote role.

Your expertise and operational mindset will contribute directly to the company's growth, scalability, and efficiency.

About the company:
The company is a US-focused direct-to-consumer footwear brand specializing in minimalist and barefoot shoes. The business sells exclusively through its own online channels and fulfills orders via a 3PL partner. Production is managed through three manufacturing partners in China. The founder oversees factory relationships, pricing negotiations, and product development, while the Supply Chain Manager owns the execution and operational side of the supply chain process.

Beyond your experience, the company is looking for someone who combines strong ownership with a systems-thinking mindset. The ideal candidate is highly organized, obsessed with inventory flow and operational simplicity, and constantly looks for ways to automate and improve processes using AI tools and modern operations software. The company values proactive problem-solvers who can work independently, communicate clearly, and thrive in a fully remote environment.

The ideal candidate should be detail-oriented, self-managed, proactive, and passionate about building efficient and scalable operational systems.

Key Responsibilities:

Supply Planning & Inventory Management:

  • Issue and manage all purchase orders based on founder-approved deals and internal sales projections
  • Maintain inventory health across approximately 500 SKUs, with a strong focus on core bestselling products
  • Build and maintain reorder models and inventory forecasting systems
  • Monitor stock levels and proactively prevent stockouts or excess inventory situations
  • Track all open purchase orders from placement to warehouse receipt

Shipping & Freight Management:

  • Source freight quotations and coordinate shipments from China to the US
  • Manage relationships with freight forwarders and oversee shipment execution
  • Monitor inbound logistics timelines to ensure smooth and timely delivery
  • Coordinate inbound receiving processes with the 3PL partner

3PL & Operational Management:

  • Own the relationship with the company's 3PL partner
  • Manage inbound coordination, warehouse receiving, and fulfillment flow
  • Ensure operational efficiency across warehousing and inventory processes
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement process improvements

Process Optimization & Automation:

  • Build and maintain SOPs for supply chain and inventory operations
  • Continuously identify manual workflows that can be automated or simplified
  • Leverage AI tools and modern operational software to improve efficiency and reduce friction
  • Create dashboards and reporting systems to improve operational visibility and decision-making

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in supply chain, purchasing, or inventory operations
  • Experience in a DTC or e-commerce company preferred
  • Experience managing purchase orders with China-based manufacturers
  • Familiarity with China-US freight operations and freight forwarder management
  • Strong ownership mentality and ability to independently manage processes remotely
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate or streamline operational workflows
  • Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail
  • Proficient in spreadsheets and inventory management tools
  • ERP/WMS experience would be an advantage
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

What Makes an Ideal Candidate:

  • Obsessed with inventory flow, operational efficiency, and process simplicity
  • Thinks in systems and proactively improves workflows
  • Naturally automates repetitive tasks and simplifies fragile processes
  • Highly proactive, reliable, and self-driven
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced remote environment without hand-holding

What's Not in Scope:

  • Factory relationship management
  • Product sourcing and price negotiations
  • Product development decisions

Our benefits:

  • Work for a fast-growing, market-proven DTC brand
  • Competitive salary
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Flexible working hours
  • High level of ownership and autonomy
  • Opportunity to directly impact operational growth and scalability
  • Supportive and performance-driven team culture

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Golang Developer to design and build high-performance backend services, infrastructure tooling, and cloud-native applications using Go. In this role you will work on systems where latency, concurrency, and operational efficiency are first-class concerns, and you will contribute to a codebase shared by engineers across multiple teams. The ideal candidate will combine strong Go expertise with broad systems knowledge, including network programming, container ecosystems, and distributed system design. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement performant backend services and APIs in Go, with strong attention to concurrency, error handling, and resource management.
  • Build cloud-native applications using Go and Kubernetes-native libraries, applying idiomatic Go patterns, well-defined module boundaries, and operational hooks that make the resulting services easy to deploy and run.
  • Develop CLI tools, Kubernetes controllers, and custom operators for internal platforms, designing clear command surfaces, robust error handling, and reconciliation logic that operates safely in long-running environments.
  • Implement gRPC and REST APIs with appropriate observability and security.
  • Profile and optimize Go applications for memory, GC, and goroutine behavior, applying systematic measurement, targeted improvements, and data-driven validation to deliver quantifiable gains in throughput, latency, or resource efficiency.
  • Integrate with messaging systems (Kafka, NATS) and data stores (PostgreSQL, Redis, etcd).
  • Build comprehensive automated tests, including unit, integration, and benchmark tests.
  • Implement structured logging, metrics emission, and distributed tracing throughout services so that operators and on-call engineers have the signals they need to diagnose issues and reason about system behavior.
  • Lead code reviews and uphold engineering standards in Go projects.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Contribute meaningfully to internal Go libraries, shared platform tooling, and reusable patterns that accelerate development across multiple engineering teams and codify hard-won best practices.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Continuously evaluate Go ecosystem evolution and contribute to internal patterns.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time in Go.
  • Strong understanding of Go concurrency patterns (goroutines, channels, contexts).
  • Hands-on experience building production gRPC and/or REST APIs in Go.
  • Experience with Kubernetes-native development (client-go, controller-runtime).
  • Solid experience with relational and key-value data stores.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems and networking fundamentals.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and container-based deployment.
  • Excellent debugging and performance-engineering skills.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Open-source contributions to Go-based projects.
  • Experience writing Kubernetes operators or controllers.
  • Familiarity with eBPF, service mesh, or low-level systems programming.
  • Exposure to security-sensitive Go projects (cryptography, auth).
  • Experience with WASM, Tinygo, or embedded systems.

raw.description:
Description

The Financial Project Analyst has for objective to track and report on the profitability of projects. This role involves collaboration with project teams, clients and internal departments to ensure the financial performance and high quality of clinical research project management services.

This role will be perfect for you if:

  • You have a solid understanding of complex enterprise processes and wish to help shape a growing finance and accounting department.
  • Working with internal and external stakeholders comes easily to you.
  • You want to learn all about the life science industry and clinical trials operations

RESPONSABILITIES

More specifically, the Project Financial Analyst must:

Project and budget set-up

  • Review and understand the client agreements and convert them into the Innovaderm internal cost structure
  • Create and configure projects in the project management and financial systems
  • Prepare and upload the project budget and related amendments impacting scope and/or timeline in the project management tool
  • Participate in the identification and the price assessment of the out-of-scope services.

Revenue / Expenses recognition and project reconciliation

As per month end schedule:

  • Ensure revenue and expenses are recognized based on Canadian GAAP and contractual requirements (including creation of journal entries for accruals and project allocation)
  • Review actual project revenues and costs compared to budget and forecast, identifying variances and their causes
  • Prepare and present detailed project financial reports, including but not limited to; profit and loss statement, financial projections (ETC and accrual report), invoicing status for internal and external stakeholders
  • Monitor and ensure accuracy of projects balance sheet accounts
  • Maintain accurate and organized financial records of project data

Invoice management

  • Review project invoicing and provide expertise as needed
  • At the end of the study, ensure all invoices were produced and paid
  • Act as the main point of contact for clients on any questions related to the invoicing

Collaboration with project team

  • Work closely with project managers to understand project requirements and financial implications
  • Provide financial guidance and support to project teams, helping them manage budgets and control costs
  • Facilitate regular financial review meetings with project managers and clients to discuss budget status, invoicing and other financial items

Internal presentations and special projects

  • Support internal and external audits by providing necessary financial documentation
  • Identify opportunities for process enhancements to increase efficiency and accuracy
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of improved financial processes and tools

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

IDEAL PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting of related field
  • CPA certification, an asset

Experience

  • minimum of 4 years of experience in project accounting

Knowledge and skills

  • Excellent knowledge of spoken and written English
  • Professional judgment and proven interpersonal skills
  • Excellent analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Critical thinking and proactive problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines
  • Proficiency with financial management tools and office software (Excel, Power BI, ERP)
  • Comfortable working in an environment in constant evolution

Our company

﻿The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Company benefits package
  • Ongoing learning and development

﻿About Indero

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale..

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in Argentina.

Our mission is to facilitate collaboration between payers and providers for mutual benefit and waste reduction, ultimately improving access to healthcare. We achieve this by aligning the common goals of payers and providers and fostering collaboration through a shared technology platform and seamless workflows.
Joining TREND Health Partners means becoming part of a dynamic, growing organization that promotes a collaborative and innovative work environment. Our comprehensive compensation package includes competitive salaries, highly valued health insurance, a 401(k) plan with employer match, paid parental leave, and more.

The Product Owner’s primary responsibility is product planning and execution of our initiatives in alignment with the product management team. This role works closely with engineering, sales, and marketing to meet revenue and customer satisfaction goals. 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with Product Management to execute on vision, strategy and roadmap
  • Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring priorities are clearly defined and stakeholder needs are accurately represented
  • Translate user needs into clear, actionable JIRA tickets
  • Define user stories and acceptance criteria that are clear, testable, and aligned to business objectives
  • Collaborate with internal teams on a routine basis to identify product needs and prioritizations
  • Support Engineering efforts in release planning, backlog refinement, execution and delivery timelines
  • Participate in testing and validation of new features to ensure functionality meets quality requirements
  • Partner with QA to ensure acceptance criteria accurately support test creation
  • Monitor feature adoption and gather feedback to inform improvements and refinements 
  • Serve as primary liaison, facilitating requirement discussions between Engineering and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer workflows, operational processes, and healthcare business needs
  • Advocate for end-user experience throughout development lifecycles
  • Escalate issues and recommendations to the Product Management as needed
  • Collaborate with Finance and other teams as needed to support business cases and ROI analysis

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, Healthcare Administration, or related field
  • Experience in project management or product lifestyle including ownership of backlog, prioritization, requirements and releases required
  • Experience with presenting to upper management
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, self-starter
  • Able to break down complex technical problems and processes
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams

    Preferred Skills
  • Demonstrate anintellectual curiosity to explore why and when behind clinical decisions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong leadership skills
  • Ability to handle complex situations
  • Experience working in Microsoft Teams and JIRA strongly preferred
  • Experience working with healthcare technology preferred
  • Background with product demonstrations strongly preferred

Mental and Physical Demands

  • This position will be exposed mainly to an indoor/office environment and will be expected to work in or around computers and printers.
  • The nature of the work is sedentary, and the employee will be sitting most of the time.
  • Essential physical functions of the job include typing and the repetitive motion to utilize computer software and hardware continuously throughout the day.
  • Essential mental functions of this position include concentrating on analytical tasks, reading information, and verbal/written communication to others continuously throughout the day.

Related Duties As Assigned

  • This job description documents the general nature and level of work but is not intended to be a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities required for this position. Consequently, employees may be asked to perform other duties as required.
  • Employees may also be asked to complete certain compliance requirements set forth by our Business Partners in the performance of their jobs including but not limited to requests for background and drug screenings and disclosures of personal health information or personally identifiable information. Exemptions as provided under the ADA and TITLE VII of the Civil Rights Act will be observed and followed.

What You’ll Do
You’ll be the kind of person who:
We are looking for a QA Test Analyst who is passionate about software quality and keen to develop expertise in automation, AI-assisted testing, and next-generation testing tools. Initially, you will work across manual testing, regression testing, test execution, and defect management within our SaaS platform. Over time, you will be expected to develop skills in automation frameworks such as Playwright, API testing, performance testing, and AI-powered testing tools. Functional Testing

  • Perform functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing.
  • Validate insurance workflows and customer journeys.
  • Identify, document, and manage defects through Jira.
  • Participate in sprint planning, refinement, and release activities.
Automation Testing
  • Maintain and execute existing automated test suites.
  • Assist in developing new automation scripts.
  • Participate in automation initiatives using: FitNesse, Playwright, Selenium, API automation tools
  • Improve automation coverage and reduce manual testing effort.
Quality Engineering
  • Support shift-left testing approaches.
  • Collaborate with developers and analysts to prevent defects early.
  • Identify opportunities to improve quality processes.
  • Help establish reusable test assets across products and projects.
  • Contribute to test data management activities.
Performance & Integration Testing
  • Execute performance and load test activities using JMeter.
  • Validate integrations between internal and third-party systems.
  • Support API and interface testing activities.
  • Assist with root cause analysis of production issues.
AI & Innovation
  • We are looking for team members excited by modern testing approaches.
  • Examples include: AI-assisted test case generation; AI-assisted defect analysis; Intelligent regression testing; Automated requirements reviews; Test script generation using AI tools; Self-healing automation frameworks; Quality analytics and predictive testing.
You will be encouraged to experiment with and adopt emerging testing technologies that improve quality, speed, and productivity.

Requirements

What You Bring
We’re looking for someone who:
  • Has 5 years software testing experience.
  • Experience executing manual test cases.
  • Strong understanding of software testing principles.
  • Experience with Jira and Agile delivery environments.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred
  • Experience with automation testing.
  • Exposure to FitNesse, Selenium, or Playwright.
  • API testing experience.
  • SQL and database validation skills.
  • Experience working on SaaS products.
  • Experience with offshore or distributed teams.
  • Insurance industry experience is advantageous.
Technical Skills
  • Current State Skills: Functional Testing; Regression Testing; UAT Support; Jira; Confluence; FitNesse; JMeter; API Testing; SQL Queries; AI Assisted Testing
  • Future State Skills: Playwright; Selenium; Test Automation Frameworks; AI-Assisted Testing; Prompt Engineering; CI/CD Pipelines; Azure DevOps; Git; Quality Engineering Practices; Continuous Testing

Are you passionate about software development for mobile network integration? Join our team to help take our telecom testing technology to new heights.

The CSG Assure team is developing an advanced telecom testing software solution used by mobile operators across the globe, including leading operators like AT&T, Tata, Orange.

CSG Assure is an artificial test traffic generation platform consisting of a cloud-based application, controllers and test probes located in around 200 countries globally.

We are looking for a skilled developer to be part of our small, agile team to build applications that help our mobile operator customers validate and optimize mobile service performance for their roamers and local subscribers.

You will develop our next-generation mobile test probe for 4G, 5G and IoT to simulate mobile users using voice, SMS and data services. Main development is done in C & C++ on Linux platform.

We think that you are a highly skilled, analytical, customer-focused person with a strong developer profile that enjoys taking responsibility, making sure our customers get full value of our high-tech solutions.

Required Skills

  • Completed Degree in Computer Science or related field

  • 5+ years of professional experience in software development, preferably in telecom

  • Strong proficiency in C++, data structures and multi-threading programming

  • Linux system knowledge

  • Solid understanding of the Radio Access Network (RAN) layer of mobile networks; the signaling and data exchange between devices and the network.

  • Good knowledge of mobile network technologies (3G, 4G, IMS/VoLTE, 5G, IoT) and network signaling (e.g. SIP, RRC, NAS) as defined in 3GPP

  • Talent for AI driven development

  • Excellent Communication, problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience in development against cellular modems; experience with either AT commands, QMI, or modem vendor SDK

  • Experience with network monitoring tools and protocol analyzers like Wireshark, QCAT

  • Familiarity with scripting languages, e.g. LUA, Shell, Perl

  • Understanding of eUICC/eSIM, GSMA standards

  • Android development experience

Why should you apply?

  • Opportunity to work and grow your skillset in cutting-edge technologies

Key Words: Senior Developer, Software Engineer, Mobile Networks, C++, Linux, Modem Communication, Telecom Software

Location(s):

India Remote

Accommodation:

If you would like to be considered for employment opportunities with CSG and need special assistance due to a disability or accommodation for a disability throughout any aspect of the application process, please call us at +1 (402) 431-7440 or email us at . CSG provides accommodations for persons with disabilities in employment, including during the hiring process and any interview and/or testing processes.

Our Guiding Principles:

Impact: Always help and empower others, whether they’re colleagues or customers. When our employees set their minds to something, great things happen.

Integrity: Do what’s right for our customers and our people while being authentic. We treat everyone with trust and respect—that’s just who we are.

Inspiration: Be bold in the way you think and passionate about the work you do. Test out innovative ideas without the fear of failure.

Our Story:

CSG empowers companies to build unforgettable experiences, making it easier for people and businesses to connect with, use and pay for the services they value most. For over 40 years, CSG's technologies and people have helped some of the world's most recognizable brands solve their toughest business challenges and evolve to meet the demands of today's digital economy.

By channeling the power of all, we make ordinary customer and employee experiences extraordinary. Our people [CSGers] are fearlessly committed and connected, high on integrity and low on ego, making us the easiest company to do business with and the best place to work. We power a culture of integrity, innovation, and impact across our locations, representing the most authentic version of ourselves to build a better future together. That's just who we are. raw.description:
At Curriculum Associates, we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award-winning learning programs like i-Ready that serve a third of the nation’s K–8 students. For more than 50 years, our commitment to making classrooms better places, serving educators, and supporting accessible learning experiences for all students has driven the continuous improvement of our innovative programs. Our team of more than 2,500 employees is composed of lifelong learners who stand behind this mission, working tirelessly to serve the educational community with world-class programs and support every day.

Summary:

Senior Business Analysts are trusted partners to the business functions they serve. Their credibility as advisors

rests on expertise they actively build and apply: deep knowledge of CA’s organizational ecosystem, fluency in how

peers and the broader industry tackle the same challenges, and command of the functional discipline itself -- the

frameworks, standards, and emerging practices that define what good looks like. This combination is what allows

them to bring recommendations grounded in both CA’s context and a wider reference point. Sr. BAs shape how

problems are framed, not just how requirements are structured. They anticipate downstream impacts before

anyone asks. They are present in the operating rhythm of the business, not just the project lifecycle. Senior BAs

also invest in the broader BA team -- mentoring peers, raising the quality bar through their own work, and

contributing to the standards and methods that define how the function operates.

This Sr. BA role will serve as the trusted partner to the Marketing function, translating marketing process and system needs into clear, actionable IT requirements. Focus areas include marketing technology (martech) systems, data flows between marketing and CRM/CDP platforms, campaign and lead-management process design, and reporting/analytics infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings IT business analysis fundamentals — requirements gathering, systems thinking, SDLC/Agile delivery — plus enough marketing domain fluency to partner credibly with Marketing stakeholders, and works cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales Operations, and IT delivery teams to scope and deliver system and process improvements.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

Business Partnership & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to business within the assigned domain -- present and accessible in the

business’s operating rhythm, not just project ceremonies.

  • Build and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders; understand their priorities, constraints, and

context well enough to anticipate needs before they’re articulated.

  • Lead discovery for complex, multi-team initiatives; facilitate workshops and alignment sessions that

produce decisions, not just documentation.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment across competing priorities; resolve independently where possible, and

know when to bring in IT Business Partnering leadership or peer domain BAs to reach the right outcome.

  • Mentor peers on discovery, stakeholder engagement, and requirements quality; contribute patterns and

examples to the broader BA practice.

Requirements & Problem Definition

  • Shape and reframe problem statements; challenge assumptions and identify root causes that stakeholders

may not have fully surfaced.

  • Structure complex, ambiguous business needs into clear, actionable requirements for high-complexity

solutions -- with minimal rework from QA or development.

  • Anticipate downstream technical and business impacts; surface risks before they become blockers.
  • Connect individual initiative requirements to broader domain and organizational priorities -- visible in

every piece of work, not just strategic conversations.

Delivery Collaboration

  • Actively shape refinement and sprint planning across complex, multi-team initiatives.
  • Hold accountability for requirements quality across the full initiative; QA and UAT surface few surprises

attributable to gaps.

  • Lead UAT coordination: own coverage, quality, and completeness across multiple teams and workstreams. · Drive post-deployment validation and change management; track adoption, surface issues before they compound, and stay present until solutions are working as intended. Domain Knowledge & Documentation · Own the accuracy, currency, and depth of process maps and documentation across the entire assigned domain -- beyond individual project cycles. · Build and apply contextual experience within the assigned domain: understanding why current processes and rules exist, what’s been tried before and what happened, where the recurring pain points are, and how the domain has evolved. · Recognize patterns that come with domain experience -- downstream impacts that aren’t obvious without context, approaches that were tried and didn’t work, trends that signal where the domain is heading -- and use that recognition to sharpen requirements and surface risks early. Knowledge Engineering & AI Enablement · Own the domain-level knowledge base: business rules, process maps, and entity definitions structured for reuse by both human practitioners and AI tools. · Design multi-step AI-assisted workflows for domain-level tasks; define the sequencing, inputs, outputs, and validation checkpoints for each. · Set validation standards for the domain -- documented criteria for what ’good enough’ looks like for AI-assisted outputs on each class of task (stories, epics, test cases, etc.). · Build and maintain a domain-level agent-readiness map: which tasks are agent-assisted, which require human judgment, and why -- reviewed quarterly. · Conduct periodic agent accuracy reviews; diagnose systematic errors at the root cause -- missing context, rule gaps, prompt quality -- not just surface symptoms. Strategic Contribution · Proactively identify functional-level gaps and opportunities; bring recommendations with supporting rationale, not just observations. · Drive improvements to BA team standards, templates, and toolkits; identify gaps and propose enhancements to the practice. · Contribute to BA hiring, onboarding, and community of practice as an active participant and knowledge contributor.

Benefits and Pay Range:

Pay Range – This role’s range is $81,500 - $139,500. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that Curriculum Associates considers in making compensation decisions based on our Compensation Philosophy. Actual base pay within that range will vary based upon several factors including, but not limited to, prior experience and relevant skill sets. At Curriculum Associates, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances for each case. This role is also eligible to participate in the company bonus plan. The Company recognizes that minimum wage varies by location and will ensure all compensation decisions comply with applicable state and local laws.

Benefits – Benefit eligible employees (and their families) are covered by medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. Employees can enroll in our company’s 401k plan and receive an employer match. Employees have access to a flexible vacation and sick policy in addition to twelve paid holidays and a winter office closure between Christmas and New Year's, as well as a number of additional perks and benefits.
