raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Do you want to join a dynamic, creative team? Samsara's Customer & Partner Education team is looking for a trainer to help us scale our reach and customer support globally. As a Senior Product Training Specialist focused primarily on our Scale segment (i.e. Commercial and Mid-market accounts), you'll help thousands of customers derive immediate value from our connected operations platform. Across one:many digital programs, live webinars, and cohort-based training sessions, you'll guide customers through structured learning journeys, make complex platform concepts accessible and actionable, and ensure success at every stage of their journey — across transportation, construction, field services, and the many other industries Samsara serves.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every session you deliver can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically design and deliver training that helps keep operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether with customers or cross-functional teams at Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Build, deliver and facilitate cohort-based one:many programs for customers, guiding groups through structured learning journeys from onboarding through advanced product adoption
  • Design new, innovative experiences tying together physical and digital assets to live sessions and/or Community experiences
  • Produce new and leverage existing training materials in accordance with team standards and brand guidelines; adapt existing materials to reflect product changes and audience needs
  • Proactively leverage in-house and external tools and platforms to optimize the training you deliver (e.g., Samsara Community, in-house AI tools; Slido)
  • Demonstrate expertise across the Samsara platform and show confidence in fielding a wide range of customer questions during live sessions
  • Manage all live session logistics, including training registration, session delivery, Q&A facilitation, polling, and post-session follow-up resources
  • Collaborate closely with the CS Scale as well as the rest of the Education team to shape content for live training and share customer feedback from training events
  • Identify common knowledge gaps across the Scale customer base and partner with Customer Success and Product teams to address them through programming
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills. You make complex platform concepts clear and compelling for large, diverse audiences, both in your verbal delivery and in the materials you produce.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering at-scale programs and live webinars or vILT to external audiences.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills. You're dynamic and enthusiastic, and you connect well with people at any level of an organization.
  • Ability to build digital learning assets when needed, e.g., video tutorials, job aids, and presentation decks, using AI models, authoring and editing tools.
  • A working grasp of instructional design: you structure content around clear learning objectives and can help shape a program, not just deliver it.
  • Self-directed and analytical. You can teach yourself new products and tools quickly and assess what customers most need to know.
  • Ability to analyze engagement and impact data, then iterate on your content to improve what's working and fix what isn't.
  • Strong prioritization skills. You handle multiple programs and sessions concurrently while staying organized, methodical, and detail-oriented.
  • An eye for detail and polish in everything you produce.
  • Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
  • 3–4 years of experience teaching or delivering training, with at least 1 year in a one-to-many or scaled delivery model.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Familiarity with webinar and virtual classroom platforms and tools
  • Experience with LMS and Community platforms, and customer education content development tools
  • Background in SaaS product training

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$80,622.50—$121,950 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

POSITION SUMMARY:Reporting to the Director, Project Management, and this role will manage internal and/or external projects related to NuScale's Small Modular Reactor Technology. The Project Manager leads a diverse team with various departments to advance the NuScale Small Modular Reactor design, fabrication and deployment. Work will be performed collaboratively with other departments to ensure delivery of project to meet customer requirements and deliver customer value while achieving cost, schedule, quality and other specified targets and objectives. Expected complexity of projects include: non-recurring projects that involve significant FOAK activities, multiyear horizon for scope, autonomous work, intensive interface with high or unknown risk significance, large commercial value.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage the overall planning and execution of project activities for assigned projects in accordance with NuScale policies and procedures.
  • Document and maintain the approved baseline, earned value planning and management, and project execution strategy in a Project Management Plan. Communicate the project baseline and requirements to the project team.
  • Interface with and support various discipline managers and teams. Supporting performing organizations with advanced project knowledge and company priority information.
  • Proactively identify and achieve resolution of project problems and anticipated challenges, including escalation of issues within the NuScale organization when necessary via effective risk and issue management.
  • Provides weekly and monthly status reports focused on project performance (earned value metrics, variance analysis, etc.), schedule and cost risk mitigations, and issue resolution to project stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with performing organization management personnel to authorize work and assign work package managers and qualified resources for project execution.
  • Develop, maintain and control project-specific plans and procedures needed for the efficient execution of the project.
  • Maintain the group’s standard of high quality and timely completion of tasks.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

CORE COMPETENCIES:To perform the job successfully, the individual should demonstrate competencies in performing the essential functions of this position by performing satisfactorily in each of these competencies.

  • Problem solving: Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner, gathers and reviews information appropriately. Uses own judgment and acts independently; seeks input from other team members as appropriate for complex or sensitive situations.
  • Oral/written communication: Listens carefully and speaks clearly and professionally in all situations. Edits work for accuracy and clarity, Is able to create, read and interpret complex written information. Ability to develop strong interpersonal networks within the organization.
  • Planning/organizing: Prioritizes and plans work activities, organizes personal and project timelines and deadlines, tracks project timelines and deadlines, and uses time efficiently.
  • Adaptability: Adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands and is able to deal with frequent interruptions, changes, delays, or unexpected events.
  • Dependability: Consistently on time and at work, responds to management expectations and solicits feedback to improve performance.
  • Team Building:Capable of developing strong interpersonal networks and trust within the organization.
  • Safety Culture: Adheres to the NuScale Safety culture and is expected to model safe behavior and influence peers to meet high standards.
  • Quality Assurance: Basic understanding or ability to understand the quality assurance regulations, standards and guidelines of 10 CFR 50 Appendix B, 10 CFR 21, and ASME NQA-1.

MINIMUM SKILLS, QUALIFICATIONS AND ABILITIES:

  • Education: A minimum of a Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or a related discipline.
  • Experience: Minimum of 10 years’ experience in project management or related field dealing with a high degree of complexity and multiple interfaces.
    • Demonstrated application of Project Management Institute (PMI) Project Management Body of Knowledge principles and processes. (required)
    • Demonstrated application of integrated cost and schedule control, or ANSI EIA-748-C Earned Value Management System practices. (required)
    • Project Management Institute (PMI) Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent certification program completion. (preferred)
    • Experienced leader for a licensed nuclear design project. The candidate will have at least basic knowledge of Pressurized Water Reactor designs.
    • Project Management experience in the nuclear industry, energy industry, power plant architect/engineering (A/E), power plant engineering procurement construction (EPC), or US Department of Energy nuclear projects. (preferred)
  • Nuclear Design/Development: An understanding of the nuclear development environment and fabrication of components related to NSSS and reactor design as regulated by the US Nuclear Regulator Committee.
  • Industry Requirements: Eligible to work under Department of Energy 10 CFR Part 810.
PHYSICAL DEMANDS:The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Ability to understand and communicate clearly using a phone, personal interaction, and computers.
  • Ability to learn new job functions and comprehend and understand new concepts quickly, and apply them accurately in a rapidly evolving environment.

  • Ability to travel locally and nationally using common forms of transportation.

Remote | Full-time

ELVTR is an online education company offering live courses led by industry experts and senior executives. Our Ukrainian engineering team builds internal systems, AI tools, operational platforms, and product improvements used across the company.

We need a hands-on IT Project Manager who can make technical delivery clear, visible, and dependable. You will work directly with our CTO and coordinate engineers and business stakeholders from the first request through release, rollout, and adoption.

This is not a Product Manager, Scrum-only, Engineering Manager, Head of Delivery, or administrative role. You will own delivery mechanics, but not product priorities, architecture, technical estimates, or people management.

What you will do

  • Keep Asana accurate across every initiative and request, including minor tickets.
  • Turn discussions into clear owners, milestones, dates, dependencies, decisions, and next steps.
  • Clarify requirements and acceptance criteria before engineering commits to work.
  • Propose and negotiate delivery plans, then track the plan confirmed by the CTO.
  • Coordinate execution, testing, releases, incidents, support, rollout, and adoption follow-through.
  • Surface blockers and slippage early, bring options, and escalate material risks through the agreed route.
  • Follow up with business stakeholders as firmly as engineers when their decisions block delivery.
  • Improve the operating process without adding unnecessary ceremony.
  • Interview stakeholders and run light business analysis when a request arrives without clear requirements — you turn ambiguity into a workable spec, not just a ticket.
  • Own user acceptance testing before release: confirm the delivered work actually solves the business problem it was meant to solve.

Requirements

  • 2-4 years of software Project Management ownership, ideally in outsourcing or IT services.
  • Fluent professional Ukrainian and strong Upper-Intermediate English, B2+ minimum; C1 preferred.
  • Direct experience with UK, US, Canadian, or European clients and distributed engineering teams is a plus.
  • Experience running 2-4 workstreams or coordinating roughly 5-15 engineers, QA, design, and DevOps specialists.
  • End-to-end experience from discovery or intake through production release, plus maintenance, support, or incidents.
  • Comfortable interviewing stakeholders and writing requirements yourself when there's no dedicated BA.
  • Practical ownership of scope, dates, dependencies, risks, change requests, and stakeholder communication.
  • Strong experience with Asana, Jira, Confluence, ClickUp, Monday.com, or a similar tool.
  • Enough technical fluency to discuss APIs, environments, QA, regression, deployments, rollbacks, databases, and incidents without pretending to be an engineer.
  • Comfort using AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to prototype small internal fixes or automations.
  • Calm judgment, polite persistence, attention to detail, and comfort influencing without line authority.
  • Earlier Business Analysis or QA experience is a strong advantage.
  • A technical degree, coding background, PMP, Scrum certification, or EdTech experience is optional.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy gym membership reimbursements, mental health benefits, generous vacation allowances, and complimentary access to all our courses.
  • Flexible Work Environment: Work remotely with a schedule that accommodates your personal and professional needs.
  • Growth Opportunities: Join a company committed to your professional development, offering abundant opportunities for career advancement.

Why You Should Join ELVTR

  • Innovative and Positive Culture: Join a team of passionate individuals who are driven by a common vision.
  • Growth Opportunities: At ELVTR, we not only believe in nurturing talent but also in providing abundant opportunities for professional development. In fact, 100% of our senior managers have been promoted to executive roles from within the company.
  • A Mission You Can Be Proud of: Be part of a brand that stands for quality, innovation, and inspiring education. Be part of a company that’s changing the face of online education, connecting students with top-tier executives.

ELVTR is committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering a diverse, inclusive environment for all, whether you join us as an employee or a contractor.

At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, we develop regulated technology that helps unlock better evidence and improve patient outcomes worldwide. Our software platforms support clinical trials, diagnostics, and medical decision-making in highly controlled regulatory environments.

As a Contract Associate within our Contracts department, you will play a hands-on role in drafting, reviewing, and supporting the negotiation of commercial agreements that enable our teams to serve clients effectively. You will manage a variety of contracting activities, working closely with Sales, subject matter experts, and colleagues across our global organization while balancing accuracy with a fast-paced, client-focused environment. If you bring practical contracting experience, strong attention to detail, and enjoy collaborating across teams, we’d love to hear from you.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match

  • Paid time off and company holidays

  • Wellness programs and Employee Assistance Program

  • Flexible/remote work options (role-dependent)

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Draft, review, redline, comment on, and edit commercial agreements, with a particular focus on Work Orders, as well as Nondisclosure/Confidentiality Agreements, Start Up Agreements, Letters of Intent, and Change Orders in accordance with Clario contracting standards.

  • Review and support negotiations of more complex agreements, including Master Service Agreements and Data Privacy Agreements, with senior oversight and appropriate escalation to subject matter experts when terms fall outside established standards or playbooks.

  • Independently manage and prioritize assigned contracting cases, accurately maintaining key legal terms, documents, and case information in Salesforce while working within client-focused turnaround expectations.

  • Collaborate professionally with Sales, subject matter experts, and cross-functional colleagues to resolve contracting questions, communicate status, and help move agreements through the contracting process efficiently.

  • Maintain accurate and organized contract files, approvals, agreement versions, and electronic signatures while supporting departmental projects, training, and audit-related activities as needed.

What We Look For

  • Relevant education and/or practical experience in commercial contracting, legal operations, contract management, or a related field; a law degree is not required.

  • Hands-on experience drafting, reviewing, redlining, commenting on, or editing contracts, with the ability to demonstrate direct involvement in contractual language rather than solely contract administration or signature processing.

  • Experience with Work Orders or similar commercial agreements; familiarity with NDAs/CDAs, MSAs, DPAs, or other commercial contracts is beneficial.

  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and tight turnaround times in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work professionally with internal stakeholders, subject matter experts, and cross-functional teams.

  • Experience using Salesforce or a comparable contract, case, or document management system; proficiency with Microsoft Word, including redlining and commenting, and working knowledge of Excel. Familiarity with Adobe or DocuSign is beneficial.

  • Ability to work remotely within the United States and collaborate effectively with colleagues across global time zones. Pharmaceutical and/or CRO industry experience is a plus.

At Clario, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

About us

Pet Media Group (PMG) is a scale-up that acquires, launches, and develops market-leading pet marketplaces globally, with over 1.5 million animals finding new homes through our platforms every year. We currently operate in 6 countries (UK, Sweden, Netherlands, Italy, Spain, and the US), all within just 5 years of launching. Here's one of our apps:

The way pets find new loving homes has remained largely unchanged for centuries. We're on a mission to change that through innovative technology, and increasingly through the intelligent use of AI. We're a young and ambitious team who have built unicorns before (e.g. Avito), backed by some of Europe's leading investors (e.g. Verdane and Otiva, early backers of Klarna, CAIA, Apotea, and Easypark).

Who are we looking for?

We're growing our Monetisation team and looking for an Engineering Manager to lead it. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll grow and support a team of engineers, own delivery and technical direction for the Monetisation domain, and stay close enough to the code to make sound calls alongside your team.

The Monetisation team works on several key parts of the business. In the VAS (value-added services) domain they build and maintain everything from pricing, checkouts and payment processing, recurring subscriptions, product activations, and experimentation/CRO. They also build and maintain an escrow system that lets users safely run the entire transaction through the platform, touching topics like KYC/KYB/identity verification, payment processing and payouts.

You'll be accountable for how this team performs: the quality of what it ships, the growth of the people on it, and how the roadmap connects daily engineering work to revenue outcomes. You'll partner closely with product and the wider engineering leadership to set priorities and clear blockers.

We also want someone who treats AI as a core part of how a modern team works. You encourage your engineers to use LLMs and AI tooling in their daily workflow, and you have a view on where the technology takes our ways of working.

What you'll do

  • Lead, grow and support a team of full-stack engineers (1:1s, career development, hiring, feedback)

  • Own delivery for the Monetisation domain: predictable, high-quality shipping against a clear roadmap

  • Set technical direction with your team and stay hands-on enough to guide architecture and unblock hard problems

  • Partner with product to shape priorities across VAS, payments and escrow

  • Champion AI-assisted engineering as a standard part of how the team builds

Requirements

We're a fast-growing scale-up. We want teams that build fast, fail fast, and learn fast. You don't need to be a world-class expert in every tool we use, but you do need a critical, open mindset, a strong engineering background, and a genuine enthusiasm for AI-assisted development.

Core (required):

  • Experience managing and growing a team of software engineers, including people development and hiring

  • Experience in the payments or fintech space (Stripe, Adyen, Braintree), or with escrow / KYC / identity verification

  • A strong engineering background yourself, ideally full-stack with TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js and React

  • A track record of owning delivery for a team or domain: turning strategy into a roadmap and shipping it

  • Comfortable staying technical: reviewing designs, guiding architecture, and making trade-offs with your team

  • Understanding of GraphQL and its usage in large systems with multiple consumers

  • Experience with relational databases like PostgreSQL

  • Active use of AI tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor, Codex) in engineering work, and a point of view on how teams should adopt them

  • Working proficiency in English is required

Bonus (helpful & appreciated):

  • Experience with monitoring & observability tools like Grafana

  • Experience with experimentation / CRO

  • Experience introducing or scaling AI coding workflows at team or company level

Our tech stack

Next.js, React, Node.js & React Native (TypeScript throughout) · GitLab CI/CD · Elasticsearch · Redis · GraphQL & PostgreSQL · Knex · Docker · Serverless with AWS Lambda · AWS · Grafana · Bitrise

What we offer

  • Join a rapidly growing, already-profitable business with a clear vision and genuine energy

  • Full ownership of a mission-critical domain and the team behind it

  • A diverse team across Sweden, Germany, Austria, UK, Poland, Portugal, Bosnia, Croatia, Ukraine and Egypt

  • A real opportunity to shape our tech department and help define how AI becomes part of how we build

  • Competitive compensation and great benefits (remote or in-person)

We very much look forward to your application, contact us if you have any questions!

raw.title: Construction Document Controller
raw.excerpt: Position Summary The Document Controller is responsible for managing, organizing, tracking, and maintaining all project documentation throughout the construction project lifecycle.
raw.description:
Position Summary

The Document Controller is responsible for managing, organizing, tracking, and maintaining all project documentation throughout the construction project lifecycle. This role ensures that drawings, specifications, submittals, RFIs, contracts, correspondence, reports, and other project records are properly controlled, distributed, stored, and readily accessible to authorized project stakeholders.

The Document Controller works closely with project managers, engineers, superintendents, subcontractors, consultants, architects, and clients to ensure that project information is accurate, current, and distributed in accordance with established document-control procedures.

Key Responsibilities

Document Management

  • Establish and maintain an organized document-control system for construction projects.
  • Receive, register, review, distribute, and archive project documents.
  • Maintain accurate document registers, logs, and tracking systems.
  • Ensure documents are correctly named, numbered, dated, and assigned the appropriate revision/status.
  • Maintain electronic and, when required, hard-copy project files.
  • Ensure obsolete or superseded documents are identified and removed from active use.

Drawings & Technical Documents

  • Control the distribution and revision of construction drawings, specifications, schedules, and technical documents.
  • Maintain current drawing registers and revision histories.
  • Distribute approved and revised drawings to relevant project teams, subcontractors, and other stakeholders.
  • Track the status of shop drawings, material submittals, samples, and other technical submissions.
  • Coordinate with engineering and project teams to ensure the latest approved information is available on site.

RFIs, Submittals & Correspondence

  • Log and track Requests for Information (RFIs), submittals, transmittals, approvals, and technical queries.
  • Monitor document workflows and follow up on outstanding items.
  • Prepare and issue transmittals and document distribution records.
  • Maintain records of project correspondence, meeting minutes, notices, and formal communications.
  • Ensure responses and approvals are properly recorded and linked to the relevant project documentation.

Project Closeout

  • Maintain complete and accurate project records throughout construction.
  • Assist with the preparation of project handover and closeout documentation.
  • Compile and organize as-built drawings, operation and maintenance manuals, warranties, certificates, inspection records, and other turnover documents.
  • Verify that required closeout documentation has been received and properly filed.
  • Support the project team in meeting contractual document-submission requirements.

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure document-control activities comply with company policies, project procedures, contractual requirements, and applicable quality standards.
  • Maintain confidentiality and security of sensitive project information.
  • Conduct periodic checks to identify missing, duplicate, incorrectly filed, or outdated documents.
  • Support project audits by providing accurate and traceable documentation.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in construction management, business administration, engineering, or a related field is preferred.
  • 2–5 years of experience in document control, project administration, construction administration, or a related construction/project environment.
  • Experience working with construction drawings, specifications, RFIs, submittals, and project correspondence.
  • Strong knowledge of document-control principles and document numbering/revision systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, and PDF/document management tools.
  • Experience with construction management/document-control platforms such as Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Aconex, Bluebeam, or similar systems is preferred.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage large volumes of documentation and competing priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with project managers, field personnel, subcontractors, consultants, and clients.
  • Ability to identify document discrepancies and follow up on missing information.
  • Strong computer and data-entry skills.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive project information.
  • Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a project team.
  • Understanding of construction terminology and project workflows.

Working Conditions

  • Primarily office/project-site based, depending on project requirements.
  • May require occasional travel between project offices and construction sites.
  • May require working extended hours to support project deadlines or critical submissions.

Performance Measures

Success in this position will be measured by:

  • Accuracy and completeness of project documentation.
  • Timely distribution and processing of project documents.
  • Effective tracking of revisions, approvals, RFIs, and submittals.
  • Accessibility and organization of project records.
  • Compliance with project document-control procedures.
  • Successful completion of project closeout and turnover documentation.
  • Positive collaboration with project teams and key stakeholders 

Requirements

This is a full time role

Rate: $7-$8/hr

100% Remote

raw.excerpt: Somos redbee, una empresa argentina de tecnología con más de 14 años de experiencia redefiniendo la forma de construir productos digitales en la industria financiera.
raw.description:
Somos redbee, una empresa argentina de tecnología con más de 14 años de experiencia redefiniendo la forma de construir productos digitales en la industria financiera. Nos apasiona co-crear soluciones innovadoras junto a nuestros clientes. Combinamos experiencia, calidad y escalabilidad para desarrollar productos estratégicos y de misión crítica. Nos destaca nuestra obsesión por aportar valor rápido y de calidad.

Estamos buscando un/a Tech Lead con sólida experiencia técnica para liderar el diseño y desarrollo de soluciones de software escalables, confiables y de alta calidad.

En este rol trabajarás de manera cercana con desarrolladores, arquitectos, Product Managers y otros equipos multidisciplinarios para definir enfoques técnicos, tomar decisiones de arquitectura y garantizar buenas prácticas de ingeniería durante todo el ciclo de desarrollo de software.

Tendrás un rol clave en la construcción y evolución de sistemas backend utilizando Go, Node.js, NestJS y arquitecturas de microservicios, combinando liderazgo técnico con participación hands-on en el desarrollo.

¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?

    ● Brindar liderazgo y orientación técnica al equipo de ingeniería durante las etapas de diseño, desarrollo, testing y despliegue de soluciones.

    ● Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener servicios backend y APIs escalables utilizando Go, Node.js y NestJS.

    ● Definir y evolucionar arquitecturas basadas en microservicios, asegurando escalabilidad, confiabilidad, mantenibilidad y una correcta separación de responsabilidades entre servicios.

    ● Participar activamente en el desarrollo de software, combinando responsabilidades de liderazgo técnico con trabajo hands-on.

    ● Liderar decisiones de arquitectura y diseño técnico en colaboración con desarrolladores, arquitectos, Product Managers y otros stakeholders.

    ● Definir y promover buenas prácticas de ingeniería de software, estándares de código, patrones de diseño y lineamientos de desarrollo.

    ● Realizar code reviews y brindar feedback técnico constructivo para mantener altos estándares de calidad.

    ● Identificar riesgos técnicos, cuellos de botella de performance y desafíos de arquitectura, proponiendo soluciones efectivas.

    ● Mentorear y acompañar a los miembros del equipo, promoviendo su crecimiento técnico y el intercambio de conocimiento.

    ● Trabajar junto a equipos multidisciplinarios para transformar requerimientos de producto y negocio en soluciones técnicas robustas.

    ● Colaborar en el diseño e implementación de prácticas confiables de despliegue y operación para aplicaciones distribuidas.

    ● Impulsar la mejora continua de los procesos de ingeniería, workflows de desarrollo y prácticas técnicas del equipo.

¿Qué esperamos de vos?

  • Experiencia avanzada y hands-on con Go (Golang).
  • Experiencia avanzada en desarrollo backend utilizando Node.js.
  • Experiencia avanzada con NestJS, incluyendo su arquitectura, patrones y ecosistema.
  • Conocimientos avanzados de arquitecturas de microservicios, incluyendo comunicación entre servicios, escalabilidad, resiliencia y diseño de sistemas distribuidos.
  • Experiencia diseñando y desarrollando APIs y servicios backend escalables.
  • Conocimientos deseables de Java (Spring Boot), SQS, Redis, SQL.
  • Conocimientos en DevOps y Cloud: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS

¿Cuál es nuestra propuesta de valor?

En redbee buscamos crear un espacio de trabajo donde las personas se sientan felices y puedan desarrollarse; por eso ofrecemos 10 días hábiles de vacaciones y adicionamos 5 días hábiles más. Trabajamos con flexibilidad y de forma remote-first y, si vivís en AMBA, nos encontramos una vez al mes en la oficina para compartir, charlar y seguir construyendo vínculos. Sí estás fuera de AMBA el trabajo es full remote. Nos interesa tu comodidad, es por eso que contamos con coworks y brindamos equipamiento para tu espacio de trabajo. Además brindamos un monto mensual de puntos para canjear en una plataforma de beneficios. Sabemos que la familia ocupa un lugar importante: ofrecemos prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar. También otorgamos licencias extendidas para que puedas estar presente en esos momentos que importan. Creemos en el aprendizaje continuo y en el crecimiento a largo plazo. Vas a tener clases de inglés, acceso a plataformas de capacitación y un plan de desarrollo claro, pensado para acompañar tu viaje dentro de redbee.
En redbee buscamos dejar huella en las trayectorias profesionales y ser una experiencia memorable en tu carrera. Creemos que la calidad técnica y la humana van de la mano, y desde ahí transformamos realidades a través de la tecnología. Si queres ser parte, ¡queremos conocerte!

Work Location:

Remote - USA

Job Type:

Part timeTo advance the purpose of InterVarsity, this position is focused on learning the basics of college campus ministry. This position is limited to students who are currently enrolled in a four-year or community college. Second year students and students enrolled at a community college may intern at a two-year/community college. Third year students and higher can work at a four-year or community college. Non-InterVarsity students who attend a Christian college must have third or fourth year standing.

GROWTH OBJECTIVES

  • Develop in college campus ministry leadership
  • Grow in spiritual understanding, biblical knowledge, ministry experience and skills, and mature as a disciple of Jesus Christ
  • Develop daily spiritual disciplines
  • Pursue spiritual relationships and involvement in a worshipping community
  • Discern God’s call to ministry service with InterVarsity and its mission

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Participate and engage fully with the campus ministry team to cast spiritual vision and direction
  • Contribute to the accomplishment of the campus ministry team’s plans for spiritual growth and transformation
  • Teach students to love, study, and apply Scripture to their lives
  • Promote the Mission on campus (to advance witnessing communities that are bolder, broader, and more ethnically diverse):
    • Seek opportunities to proclaim and demonstrate the Gospel of Jesus Christ
    • Learn to guide chapters (or assigned segments of a chapter) in the development of strategic thinking regarding witness to the university
    • Learn to model and assist students and faculty in growing in their love for God's people of every ethnicity and culture
  • Encourage a prayerful lifestyle in students, especially focusing on those who do not yet follow Jesus as Lord and Savior
  • Engage positively with the supervision and training you receive from your staff ministry trainer and/or director
  • Assist with reporting as assigned
  • Serve as an ambassador of InterVarsity to individual ministry partners and churches, through prayer, discussion of ministry efforts, mission, and accomplishments
  • Other duties as assigned by supervisor

QUALIFICATIONS

  • A follower of Jesus Christ
  • Annually affirm InterVarsity’s Statement of Agreement
  • A developing passion for evangelism
  • Demonstrates campus ministry leadership qualities such as initiative, self-awareness and cultural awareness, communication, professionalism, eagerness to learn, cross-cultural competence, teamwork, and relational maturity.
Pay Range: $32,256.00 - $43,020.00 per year

Pay: This position is funded through personal fundraising. Accordingly, compensation will vary based on the ability of the individual to secure a donor team to fund the cost of his/her salary. The actual salary received,including any geographic adjustment to account for location and cost of living, is subject to the individual’s ability to raise funds necessary to cover the full amount of such salary within the range set forth in the job posting details.

  • 403(b) matching contributions

  • Dental insurance

  • Employee assistance program

  • Employee discounts

  • Flexible work schedule

  • Flexible spending accounts

  • Health insurance

  • Health savings account

  • Life insurance

  • Paid time off

  • Parental leave

  • Professional development assistance

  • Vision insurance

Equal Employment Opportunity:

InterVarsity Christian Fellowship/USA is both an equal opportunity employer and a faith-based religious organization. We conduct hiring without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, sex, marital status, parental status, membership in any labor organization, political ideology, or disability of an otherwise qualified individual. The status of InterVarsity Christian Fellowship/USA as an equal opportunity employer does not prevent the organization from hiring staff based on their religious beliefs so that all staff share the same religious commitment.  Pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e 1(a)) InterVarsity Christian Fellowship/USA has the right to, and does, hire only candidates who agree with InterVarsity’s Statement of Agreement: Purpose and Doctrinal Basisbecause InterVarsity believes that each and every staff plays a vital role in advancing InterVarsity’s mission and purposes.

raw.description:
Job Description:

The Director of Data Platforms is responsible for leading a function and/or collection of teams within CSI's data engineering organization in the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of secure, scalable, well-governed data platforms and pipelines across CSI's banking and fintech solutions. This position executes the data platform technology vision and organizational plans in conformance with the company's policies and the objectives of senior management, and is responsible for the workload, outputs, and resources within the data engineering function. The Director establishes short- and long-term goals, standards, and processes that align data platform delivery with broader product, analytics, and AI strategies, leads a team of engineering managers, and champions continuous improvement and strong governance across the data lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Organizational Management

  • Directs a department of data engineers, data architects, quality engineers, and other individual contributors to achieve strategic and operational goals for CSI's data platforms.
  • Inspires, coaches, and provides guidance to team members to improve performance, drive accountability, and support achievement of business objectives.
  • Partners with senior leadership on the data platform vision and strategy, helping shape the future-state data engineering organization.
  • Communicates organizational priorities, policy, and strategy clearly across the department.
  • Champions a culture of ownership, initiative, continuous improvement, and strong data stewardship.
  • Upholds all policies and procedures, company culture, and values.

Data Platform Delivery & Engineering Oversight

  • Owns the quality of data pipelines, warehouses, and platforms delivered, and the implementation of standards, methods, metrics, and procedures across the data engineering lifecycle, evaluating and refining as needed with other leaders in the organization.
  • Directs the architecture, performance, and cost management of CSI's Snowflake environment, including warehouse sizing, workload management, and credit optimization.
  • Drives a sense of urgency for platform and process improvement to meet and exceed internal and customer data requirements.
  • Applies lean principles to reduce pipeline cycle time and eliminate waste across the data development process.
  • Works with other leaders to standardize data engineering practices, including data modeling, pipeline testing, transformation standards (e.g., dbt), documentation, and reporting on overall platform performance.
  • Reviews and approves data platform releases, schema changes, and deployment plans, ensuring delivery risk is appropriately identified and managed.
  • Leads or supports root cause analysis on significant data quality incidents or pipeline failures in partnership with engineering teams and drives preventive action.

Data Governance, Classification & Audit

  • Owns and matures CSI's data governance framework, including data classification standards (e.g., confidential, PII, non-public personal information), data lineage, cataloging, and retention practices.
  • Serves as a primary point of contact for internal and external audit teams on matters related to data platform controls, access governance, and evidence collection.
  • Partners with Compliance, Risk, and Legal to ensure data governance practices align with applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., GLBA, SOC 2, state privacy laws) and internal policy.
  • Establishes and maintains audit trails, access reviews, and lineage documentation sufficient to support SOC 2 assessments, regulatory exams, and third-party audits.
  • Implements and enforces role-based access control (RBAC) and least-privilege principles across Snowflake and other data platforms.
  • Leads data quality monitoring, issue remediation, and metadata management programs to build organizational trust in reported data.

Operational Performance & Process Improvement

  • Establishes and reviews reporting and dashboards that track departmental priorities, platform reliability, data quality, and goal achievement.
  • Prepares and manages budgets for the data engineering department, including Snowflake and related platform spend, and monitors spend against plan.
  • Leads or contributes to yearly budget and headcount planning for the organization.
  • Ensures appropriate staffing levels, effective workload balance, and scalable data engineering practices across teams.
  • Uses engineering and data metrics/KPIs (e.g., pipeline reliability, data quality, query performance, cost per workload) to measure team performance and drive targeted, continuous improvement actions.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Works closely with product, analytics, data science/AI, and QA teams to define data platform requirements and data-related metrics.
  • Partners with security, risk, and vendor management on due diligence, audit evidence, and response to RFP or security questionnaires as needed.
  • Partners with internal and external audit teams on a recurring basis to support control testing, evidence requests, and remediation of findings.
  • Partners with infrastructure and operations teams as required and appropriate on capacity planning, hosting, and platform reliability.
  • Works effectively with all levels of leadership, including business and customer-facing stakeholders, to support delivery success.
  • Stays current on industry trends, data engineering best practices, and the broader data/analytics stack to support team readiness and capability development.
  • Partners with infrastructure and network teams to resolve technical integration challenges as acquired platforms and data sources are brought into CSI's broader data environment.

People Leadership

  • Leads, mentors, and evaluates managers, including regular 1:1s, goal setting, coaching, and performance review processes.
  • Participates in interviews and hiring decisions for data engineering leadership and key technical roles.
  • Builds high-performing teams that demonstrate accountability, adaptability, and strong employee engagement.
  • Demonstrates a track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining high-quality data engineering talent.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Oversees access control processes for data platforms and engineering systems, ensuring appropriate approvals and audit trails.
  • Supports initiatives to reduce reliance on shared credentials and strengthen controls around production and data access.
  • Partners with vendor management on contract review, vendor risk, and cost control for data platform vendors and tools (e.g., Snowflake, ELT/ETL tooling, data catalogs).
  • Owns SOC 2 and other audit or compliance efforts as they relate to data platforms, ensuring timely and complete evidence collection from engineering teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including a strong technical background as an individual contributor on data platforms.
  • Proven, hands-on experience with Snowflake required, including architecture, performance tuning, security model, and cost/credit management.
  • Proven experience managing managers and leading multi-layered data engineering teams in a complex environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in data governance, data classification, and metadata management practices across large teams.
  • Direct experience supporting internal and external audit engagements, including evidence collection, control testing, and remediation.
  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies.
  • Demonstrated success recruiting, developing, and retaining high-quality data engineering teams.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to present technical and business information to a wide audience including auditors, customers, peers, and staff.
  • Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills; comfortable operating with ambiguity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in banking, fintech, or financial services, including regulated data environments.
  • Experience with the modern data stack (e.g., Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Fivetran, or similar ELT/ETL and orchestration tools) and cloud platforms (AWS or Azure).
  • Experience with data catalog and lineage tooling (e.g., Collibra, Alation, Atlan) and classification/tagging frameworks.
  • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance frameworks relevant to banking data (e.g., GLBA, HMDA, SOC 2).
  • Deep experience working with either Atlassian Jira or Azure DevOps to manage data engineering SDLC.
  • Experience driving change across a complex, global engineering organization.
  • Familiarity with vendor management and security or RFP response processes.

What Success Looks Like

  • Engineering teams are well-prepared, supported, and consistently meet delivery expectations.
  • Data platforms deliver secure, high-quality, well-governed data on predictable cadences with continually improving pipeline reliability.
  • Data classification, lineage, and access governance are consistently applied across all data assets.
  • Internal and external audits proceed smoothly, with evidence readily available and findings proactively remediated.
  • The Snowflake environment is optimized for cost, performance, and security.
  • Leadership has clear visibility into data platform priorities, progress, and performance through KPIs and dashboards.
  • CSI's data engineering organization continues to evolve toward a stronger, more resilient, and well-governed data foundation.

In addition to its award-winning core banking platform, these include the latest in lending, digital banking, payments, financial crime prevention and cybersecurity. Building on its 60-year track record of personalized service, CSI is shaping the future of banking and empowering its customers to rival their competition. For more information about CSI, visit

What is PerfectServe?

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.

PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.

Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:
  1. In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.
  2. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.
At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.

If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

The Technical Lead supports a portfolio of customers and provides technical expertise to account teams and clients, driving optimization, adoption, and ensuring service excellence. • Understand clinical workflows and apply PerfectServe solutions to improve them.
• Partner with customer contacts to enhance adoption, train on self-administration best practices, and optimize account configurations.
• Utilize Zendesk to ensure accurate and timely resolution of service requests in collaboration with the Support Center.
• Manage, resolve and document complex and escalated requests and configuration changes.

What You Will Bring

• Ability to manage multiple tasks and resolve technical issues under pressure.
• Excellent relationship-building, written, and verbal communication skills.
• Exceptional customer service mindset with a commitment to exceeding expectations.
• Adaptability, strong work ethic, and motivation to grow professionally.

Essential Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

• 2+ years experience supporting SaaS customers or troubleshooting technical workflows.

• Proficiency in reporting tools (e.g., Looker) is a plus.
• Ability to travel occasionally (less than 10%).

Why Join PerfectServe?

At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission-driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation.

We offer a salary range of $50,000 - $55,000 USD per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and potential to grow within the team. If you are a current employee and have questions about how your compensation aligns with our ranges, we encourage you to speak with your manager or People Operations.

Boundless Life is a family-focused living, working and academy operator building a new model for how families live, their children learn, and parents work around the world. Across eight global destinations — Sintra (Portugal), Syros (Greece), Tuscany (Italy), Andalusia (Spain), Kotor (Montenegro), Bali (Indonesia), Kamakura (Japan), and La Barra (Uruguay) — we offer families the infrastructure to spend one, three, or 6+ months living in a new country: fully furnished homes, dedicated coworking hubs, and our own academy project based learning programs for children ages 1.5 -14.9 years old.

Our members are professionals, entrepreneurs, remote workers, and their families who want their children to grow up as global citizens without pausing their careers or their kids' education. We are asset-light where we can be, hybrid where it makes sense, and long-term partners with our landlords and local communities in every market we enter.

The future of family life and work is global, seamless, and community-driven — and we are building it. Join us as we scale toward our next wave of destinations across Europe, Asia, and the Americas.

About The Opportunity

Boundless Life is seeking a highly capable Real Estate Legal Transaction Manager to join our Real Estate & Expansion team and support the growth of our global portfolio across eight active markets today, an active expansion pipeline.

The ideal candidate will bring solid, hands-on experience in commercial real estate legal practice — with a particular focus on complex, multi-jurisdictional lease negotiations and hybrid deal structures (leases with management, operating, or revenue-share components).

This role will serve as a dedicated legal transaction partner to the Real Estate & Expansion team, reporting directly to the General Legal Counsel and working shoulder-to-shoulder with our Global Head of Real Estate, in-house counsel, external local counsel, and business stakeholders across each market. A core focus of the role is the negotiation, drafting, and interpretation of commercial and residential leases, together with all associated ancillary documents — LOIs, addenda, side letters, management agreements, SNDAs, estoppels, guarantees, and building/regulatory authorizations.

Beyond transactional execution, the successful candidate will help build the legal-operational backbone of a fast-growing global platform: standardizing playbooks, coordinating local counsel across jurisdictions, and translating legal risk into commercially usable guidance for the business.

Boundless Life operates across eight very different legal environments — from Portuguese and Spanish commercial lease frameworks to Indonesian Hak Pakai regimes, Italian, Greek, and Montenegrin civil law traditions, and Japanese and Uruguayan market practice — with active expansion pipeline (France, Costa Rica) adding further complexity. Candidates must be comfortable quickly grasping the intricacies of new jurisdictions, working through unfamiliar frameworks with local counsel, and holding the commercial line while doing so.

This position reports to the General Counsel, with a strong working line into the Head of Real Estate & Expansion. Location is flexible (remote-friendly, EMEA time zone preferred), with regular travel expected to active and prospective markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Transactional Execution: Lead the drafting and negotiation of a diverse deal flow, including commercial leases (education centers, coworking hubs, family lounges), residential portfolio leases and management agreements, LOIs, MOUs, lease amendments, SNDAs, estoppels, guarantees, and hybrid lease-plus-management structures. Ensure every document protects Boundless Life's commercial and operational interests while unblocking the growth pipeline.
  • Multi-Jurisdictional Coordination: Manage and quality-control external local counsel across our active markets (currently Portugal, Greece, Italy, Spain, Montenegro, Indonesia, Japan, and Uruguay), our active expansion markets (France, Costa Rica), and any new jurisdiction we enter. Own the relationship, the scope, and the output — including translating local legal advice into clear, actionable direction for the business.
  • Asset Management & Operational Support: Provide legal interpretation of the existing lease portfolio and day-to-day support to Operations, Finance, Local Hosts, and Community teams on lease questions, escalations, disputes, permits, and landlord communications.
  • Real Estate Due Diligence: Lead legal due diligence on new locations and strategic initiatives — identifying and pricing regulatory, title, zoning, ERP/permitting, tax withholding, and structural risks — and translating findings into go/no-go recommendations.
  • Playbook & Process Optimization: Help build the RE Legal function from the inside out: templates, redline playbooks by jurisdiction, approval workflows, contract repository standards, and lease management processes. Turn one-off work into repeatable systems.
  • Strategic and Practical Legal Advice: Deliver timely, commercially oriented legal advice to internal stakeholders across all levels — from Development Managers and Project Managers up to the CEO and Board — translating complex legal concepts into clear, risk-based recommendations the business can act on.
  • Dispute Management: Support the resolution of landlord, tenant, and vendor disputes across markets, working with local counsel where litigation, arbitration, or termination scenarios arise.

About You

  • Education: Law degree (JD, LLB, Licenciatura en Derecho, or foreign equivalent) from an accredited institution. LLM or dual-jurisdiction qualification is a plus.
  • Bar Admission: Qualified to practice law in at least one relevant jurisdiction.
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of direct experience in commercial real estate, contract management and leasing practice OR 7 years dealing with high volume complex commercial agreements. A background combining top-tier law firm training with in-house exposure is strongly preferred. Prior experience in hospitality, coliving, education, or multi-jurisdictional real estate portfolios is a significant plus.
  • Languages — Required: Excellent professional proficiency in both English and Spanish, spoken and written. Comfortable negotiating and drafting complex legal documents in both languages.
  • Languages — Strong Plus: Working proficiency in one or more of: Portuguese, Italian, French, or Japanese. Given the geographic footprint, any additional Boundless Life market language materially improves the fit.
  • Multi-Market Fluency: Demonstrated ability to quickly grasp the intricacies of new legal systems, distinguish market convention from negotiable position, and work effectively with local counsel across civil and common law jurisdictions.
  • Technical Mastery: Proven ability to identify novel and complex legal issues, escalate them appropriately, and translate them into clear, risk-based recommendations for both business and legal stakeholders.
  • Judgement & Ownership: Takes full ownership of work product. Operates effectively and independently with minimal oversight, while maintaining a high standard of accuracy, quality, and efficiency.
  • Organizational Skills: Exceptional organization and prioritization. Comfortable holding many parallel workstreams — often across multiple time zones and markets — without dropping detail or missing deadlines.
  • Travel: Willing and able to travel regularly (indicatively 15–25% of the time) to active and prospective markets for site visits, negotiations, and closings.
  • Cultural Fit: Collaborative, low-ego, mission-aligned. Comfortable in a fast-paced, ever-evolving scale-up environment where roles stretch, priorities shift, and resilience matters. Believes in what Boundless Life is building for families.

What's next?

  • First call with our Recruiter (30 min)
  • Interview with the Head of Real Estate (60 min)
  • Final call with the Hiring Manager (60 min)

The process might change slightly as we go along - we’ll keep you posted at all times.

Want to know more about working at Boundless Life? Check out our story!

Do you love turning business goals into smart marketing plans that get results? Are you energized by collaboration, curious about what’s next, and always looking for a smarter way to connect with an audience?
CAA Saskatchewan is looking for an experienced Marketing Specialist to join our Marketing and Communications team. This is a role for a strategic thinker, confident project lead, and enthusiastic idea generator who can see both the big picture and the details that bring it to life.
Reporting to the Manager, Marketing and Communications, you’ll lead integrated marketing initiatives focused on membership acquisition, retention, and member rewards. You’ll work alongside a talented, collaborative team to build campaigns that strengthen the CAA brand, attract new members, deepen member relationships, and demonstrate the value of CAA membership.
You must live in Saskatchewan to be considered for this position. Flexible and remote-work arrangements within the province may be available.
About CAA Saskatchewan
For more than 100 years, CAA has helped people stay safe, connected, and on the move. Today, we’re a trusted part of life across the province, from roadside assistance and travel to insurance, rewards, and everyday member benefits.
We’re proud of our history and excited about what’s next. Our team values fresh thinking, genuine collaboration, continuous learning, and work that makes a meaningful difference for our members.

Requirements

What You’ll Do
Strategy & Planning
  • Lead integrated marketing initiatives that support membership acquisition, retention, and member rewards.
  • Turn business goals and audience insights into clear campaign strategies, briefs, budgets, KPIs, and channel plans.
  • Partner with internal teams and external agencies to develop compelling, results-driven campaigns.
  • Act as the marketing lead for assigned initiatives, bringing forward recommendations and opportunities to improve member engagement and business results.
  • Share campaign priorities, performance, insights, and recommendations with business partners and the broader marketing team.
Execution & Optimization
  • Lead campaigns from brief through launch, managing timelines, budgets, creative, approvals, and deliverables.
  • Execute and optimize campaigns across paid, owned, and earned channels, including social, digital advertising, and email.
  • Use Asana and HubSpot to manage projects, support campaign execution, and track performance.
  • Build clear post-campaign reporting that turns results into actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Identify challenges, solve problems, and continuously improve how we plan, execute, and measure membership marketing.
What You Bring
  • 5+ years of marketing experience, with demonstrated experience leading integrated, multi-channel campaigns.
  • A degree or diploma in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
  • Strong strategic, analytical, and project-management skills, with the ability to turn business objectives and audience insights into effective marketing plans.
  • Experience across digital advertising, social media, email marketing, and marketing technology; experience with HubSpot and Asana is an asset.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, combined with curiosity, initiative, sound judgment, and a collaborative approach.

Benefits

Why Join CAA Saskatchewan?
  • Make an impact: Help shape how one of Saskatchewan’s most trusted brands attracts, retains, and engages its members.
  • Own meaningful work: Lead membership campaigns from strategy through execution, measurement, and optimization.
  • Shape the member experience: Help attract new members, strengthen retention, and create more member value through our rewards program.
  • Bring your ideas: Join a team that values fresh thinking, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Flexibility and benefits: Enjoy flexible work options, competitive compensation, and a comprehensive benefits package.
Ready to Bring Your Ideas to CAA?
If you’re an experienced marketer who thinks strategically, collaborates naturally, and gets excited about turning business goals into marketing that delivers results, we’d love to hear from you.

If you are interested in this career opportunity, please apply directly at Jobs at CAA Saskatchewan

At Curriculum Associates, we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award-winning learning programs like i-Ready that serve a third of the nation’s K–8 students. For more than 50 years, our commitment to making classrooms better places, serving educators, and supporting accessible learning experiences for all students has driven the continuous improvement of our innovative programs. Our team of more than 2,500 employees is composed of lifelong learners who stand behind this mission, working tirelessly to serve the educational community with world-class programs and support every day.

Essential duties/responsibilities: 

  • Execute content development tasks (instructor-led training, eLearning, microlearning, and other formats) to support literacy product training for IST.

  • Lead content development across multiple formats and content areas for literacy products, including higher-visibility deliverables.

  • Serve as the subject matter expert and go-to resource for literacy product content, reducing rework and equipping IST to effectively support and train on literacy products.

  • Serve as a primary point of contact between LXR and IST on literacy product learning needs.

  • Synthesize input from the Stakeholder Program Manager, Product Development, and Product Marketing to inform literacy content strategy.

  • Partner with Content and Learning Experience Program Managers to ensure literacy training aligns with platform capabilities, established content standards, and learner needs.

  • Support learning management system (LMS) administration and content uploads for literacy learning materials.

  • Facilitate training sessions as needed, including scheduled events and ad hoc requests, to support IST readiness.

  • Manage timelines and deliverables for literacy content production and deployment.

  • Support content quality reviews and contribute to process documentation and best practices for literacy content development.

  • Incorporate stakeholder and learner feedback to continuously improve literacy training content; proactively flag content gaps or inconsistencies.

  • Ensure all literacy content meets accessibility, inclusivity, and regulatory compliance standards.

Required Job Skills and Abilities: 

  • Ability to guide literacy content development, training, and strategy based on deep subject-matterexpertise in K–12 literacy instruction and curriculum.

  • Ability to translate stakeholder learning needs into high-quality, learner-centered content across formats (instructor-led training, eLearning, microlearning).

  • Ability to create, manage, and deliver accurate, timely, and engaging literacy training materials.

  • Ability to synthesize input from Product Development, Product Marketing, and Program Managers to align content strategy.

  • Ability to deliver both formal and ad hoc training sessions, adapting delivery methods to meet IST needs.

  • Ability to manage timelines, deliverables, and deployment of learning materials across multiple concurrent initiatives.

  • Ability to review literacy content for accuracy, consistency, and quality.

  • Familiarity with learning management systems (LMS), authoring tools, and digital learning platforms.

  • Knowledge of best practices for accessible, inclusive, and compliant learning content.

  • Ability to interpret stakeholder and learner feedback to inform content quality review and revisions.

Required Education and Experience: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Education, Literacy, Communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • 3+ years of experience in learning and development or content development, preferably within K–12 education or publishing.

  • Working knowledge of K–12 literacy curriculum standards and instructional needs.

  • Experience with learning platforms, authoring tools, or other content-development technology preferred.

Travel: Minimal (less than twice per month); may include occasional travel to support in-person training or content delivery.

Working Environment: Standard office/remote working environment; regularly uses a computer for extended periods, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Benefits and Pay Range:

Pay Range – This role’s range is $69,250 - $118,250. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that Curriculum Associates considers in making compensation decisions based on our Compensation Philosophy. Actual base pay within that range will vary based upon several factors including, but not limited to, prior experience and relevant skill sets. At Curriculum Associates, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances for each case. This role is also eligible to participate in the company bonus plan. The Company recognizes that minimum wage varies by location and will ensure all compensation decisions comply with applicable state and local laws.

Benefits – Benefit eligible employees (and their families) are covered by medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. Employees can enroll in our company’s 401k plan and receive an employer match. Employees have access to a flexible vacation and sick policy in addition to twelve paid holidays and a winter office closure between Christmas and New Year's, as well as a number of additional perks and benefits.
