Exodigo is the leading underground mapping solution for non-intrusive discovery. Our platforms combine multi-sensor fusion, 3D imaging, and AI technologies to create complete, accurate underground maps that enable confident decision-making for customers across the built world. We transform the project lifecycle for our customers, who include key community stakeholders in the utilities, transportation and government sectors.

We are experiencing sky-rocketing growth and closed a historically large $96M Series B round in July of 2025.

Job description

As Exodigo expands our offering beyond subsurface utility mapping into a full suite of engineering services, we’re seeking a Strategic Pursuits Manager to play a pivotal role in helping us drive our next phase of growth and market expansion. The Strategic Pursuits Manager is both a storyteller and strategist — someone who thrives on solving complex challenges, crafting winning strategies, and bringing together teams to deliver standout proposals that secure critical contracts. You will take ownership of developing compelling, data-driven, and client-focused proposals that clearly demonstrate Exodigo’s value to transit agencies, state Departments of Transportation, municipalities, public utilities, engineering firms, and contractors.

You will partner closely with sales, operations, legal, finance, and leadership to deeply understand each client’s challenges, align Exodigo’s technical and operational strengths to their goals, and translate that into persuasive narratives that win. Your creativity, strategic thinking, and commitment to excellence will be instrumental in ensuring the Pursuits Team — and Exodigo as a whole — meets and exceeds our goals.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinate cross-functionally and with external partners to develop strategies for winning high-stakes, competitive procurements;
  • Write, review, proofread, and edit comprehensive long-form proposal submissions to potential partners, such as state Departments of Transportation, transit agencies, and utility companies;
  • Communicate Exodigo’s ability to address a potential client’s needs in the context of our technology and operational capabilities;
  • Absorb complex specifications and distill them into easily-digestible prose for potential clients; and
  • Contribute at multiple procurement stages, including bid evaluation, win strategy development, proposal generation, interviewing, and contract negotiation.

Requirements

  • 5–8 years of experience in proposal management or business development within infrastructure, transportation, utilities, or engineering sectors
  • Proven success leading formal procurement efforts, including overseeing proposal generation, client communication, interview preparation, and contract negotiation
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to translate complex technical information into clear, compelling, and client-tailored content
  • Highly collaborative team player who leads by example, stepping up where needed and supporting others in achieving shared goals
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration and use of sales operations and enablement tools (e.g., Salesforce, Enablix)
  • Bachelor’s degree in a liberal arts discipline (e.g., English, history) is preferred; advanced liberal arts or business degree is a plus

Salary Range: $106,000 - $150,0000

Location: Remote — West Coast-based candidates preferred

Learn more

Why Join Us

  • Opportunity to shape sales strategy and make a direct impact on company growt
  • Exposure to cutting-edge solutions transforming digital infrastructure and data center development
  • Collaborative, no-ego team environment focused on customer impact
  • Remote-first culture with flexibility and autonomy

Our mission is to power the next era of underground exploration – saving time, money, lives, and the planet. We are focused, intentional, confident, and hard working. We solve big problems, but we are approachable, open-minded, and love hard questions.

About the Role

OutsourcedIn is looking to hire an experienced Project Manager / Contracts Administrator to provide remote project and contracts support across residential construction projects in New South Wales.

This role requires a highly capable residential construction professional with strong contracts administration and project coordination experience, able to work independently while supporting onshore Construction Managers, Site Supervisors, Directors, and external consultants.

This is a fully remote role, embedded within the clients project delivery team.

Project Management (Remote Support)

  • Monitor construction progress and flag risks or delays

  • Coordinate subcontractors, suppliers, and consultants

Contracts Administration

raw.title: Pricing & Packaging Lead
raw.excerpt: About HightouchHightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP.
raw.description:
About Hightouch

Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible.

Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.

At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.

The Role

We're hiring our first dedicated Pricing & Packaging Lead. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who wants to own how Hightouch monetizes, not administer a rate card someone else set.

Hightouch has grown from 10 to 100 account executives in under two years, and the product has diversified well beyond its Reverse ETL origins: Customer Studio, Identity Resolution, Journeys, Event Collection and Real-Time Audiences, Match Booster, and a fast-expanding set of AI products with a base + consumption pricing profile. Each launched with its own pricing logic, and the frameworks that got us here won't get us to the next stage. We need a central lead who owns the whole picture, from strategy through the systems that make it real, and who is in the room with our Co-CEOs, CRO, CFO, and product leaders as new pricing gets designed.

This role reports to our Head of Revenue Operations and sits alongside the Deal Desk Lead. Deal Desk owns the transaction: structuring, approvals, and quote accuracy on individual deals. You own the frameworks Deal Desk enforces, and you'll partner with Deal Desk and our front-line sales managers (AEMs) on the largest deals. You'll be hands-on-keyboard from day one and are expected to be a builder and scaler.

What You'll Do

Co-create pricing and packaging with executive and product leadership. Own the pricing and packaging agenda. Partner directly with our Co-CEOs, CRO, CFO, and Product leaders on how new products get packaged, metered, and priced: value metrics, tiers, platform fee structure, commit and drawdown mechanics, overage and true-up rules, floors, and how it all lands on an order form. Run the pricing workstream for every material launch so pricing is decided before the product ships. Build the analysis behind each decision (willingness-to-pay, win/loss and discount data, competitive benchmarking, margin and rev-rec implications) and bring a recommendation, not a menu. Own the decision through rollout, then pressure-test it against real deals and revise where it breaks.

Rationalize and own the current pricing frameworks. Inventory everything we sell and how we price it today, across Platform, Customer Studio, AI products, Event Collection and RTA, Match Booster, and adjacent SKUs. Consolidate overlapping or contradictory frameworks into one coherent price book with clear list prices, unit definitions, bundling rules, and discount guidance by segment and deal size. Define what is standard, what is an exception, and what we no longer offer. Set uplift and repricing standards for renewals and expansions, including how legacy contracts migrate onto current packaging. Report discount depth, price realization, and packaging mix to leadership on a regular cadence.

Build the pricing enablement and calculation tooling for the field. Make it easy for 100+ AEs and their managers to quote correctly and defend the price. Own the Pricing Enablement Hub and the reference documentation reps actually use. Build calculators and scoping tools (usage scoping, consumption estimators, bundle and multi-year configurators, approval-threshold lookups) that produce a defensible quote in minutes. Partner with Revenue Enablement to train reps on pricing, packaging, value positioning, and negotiation guardrails.

Partner with Deal Desk and AEMs on large and complex deals. For seven-figure, multi-product, multi-year, or otherwise non-standard opportunities, you're in the deal early with the AEM, AE, and Deal Desk Lead, shaping the commercial structure: how to package a converged platform deal, how to ramp a consumption commit, where the walk-away is, and what precedent a concession sets. Where a deal exposes a hole in the framework, you close it so the next deal doesn't need an exception.

Own business requirements for product price books in CPQ. Be the business owner of how our product catalog, price books, pricing rules, bundles, consumption and overage logic, and approval thresholds are represented in CPQ. Write and prioritize requirements, define acceptance criteria, and work with GTM Systems on implementation and testing. Hold the line on data model decisions that determine whether billing, ARR reporting, product-level compensation, and margin analysis are trustworthy downstream. Own price book governance once live.

Advise GTM Compensation on commission by product. Utilize analysis of margins and pricing dynamics to suggest differential commission rates or incentive structures for sellers.

Who You Are

  • You've owned pricing and packaging at a high-growth B2B SaaS company, ideally through product diversification or a pricing-model transition, selling into enterprise at multi-$100K and $1M+ price points. You've built price books, not just analyzed them.
  • You've priced consumption and hybrid models, not just seats. You understand value metrics, commits, drawdown, overage, minimums, and true-ups, and the revenue-recognition and forecasting headaches hybrid models create. Launching pricing for AI or usage-metered products is a strong plus.
  • You've worked directly with founders and executives on pricing decisions. You build the analysis, form a recommendation, defend it in a room with strong opinions, and execute the decision even when it wasn't your first choice. Leaders trust you because you tell them what you actually think.
  • You build pricing models approved by Finance. You drive analysis including margin and revenue impact scenarios, understand how to translate P&L prerogatives into customer action, and respect cost levers when setting pricing and discount structures.
  • You've been close to deals. You've sat with sellers and deal desk on large, complex opportunities and know how pricing strategy meets negotiation reality. You understand that confusing pricing costs real revenue and rep time, and you're energized by making it simple.
  • You've written pricing requirements for CPQ or quote-to-cash systems. You understand product catalogs, price book structures, and pricing rules, and how those choices propagate into billing, ARR reporting, and compensation. You don't need to configure Salesforce yourself, but you speak the language and own the outcome.
  • You build tools people use. Your calculators, scoping models, and reference guides get adopted because they're faster than the alternative. You're fluent in spreadsheets, BI tools, SQL, and increasingly in AI tooling.
  • You think from first principles and ship iteratively. You ask why, build a hypothesis, test it, and update fast. You'd rather fix the top three price book problems this quarter than spend six months on a redesign that lands too late, and you're eager to learn how Hightouch actually runs rather than apply what worked at your last company.

Compensation & Benefits

The salary range for this position is $200,000 to $260,000 per year, which is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. We also offer meaningful equity compensation in the form of ISO options, and offer early exercise and a 10 year post-termination exercise window.

E-Verify Statement

Hightouch participates in E-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post-hire only — we never use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants.

About the Role

RPMGlobal (RPM) is seeking full-stack Software Engineers to join our development team and help build the software platforms that power high-precision spatial data processing, visualisation, and analysis for some of the world’s largest and most complex mining operations.

You will work across the stack, from modern web applications and interactive 2D/3D experiences to APIs, and distributed backend services, and cloud and edge systems, operating directly at mine sites.

These roles are ideal for experienced software engineers who enjoy solving complex technical problems and building reliable products that connect geospatial data, AI, computer vision, and real-world operations.

These are full-time roles, and while they are remote, candidates must be based in Guadalajara.

To be considered for this role, please submit your application in English.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable web applications, 2D/3D experiences, and backend services for interacting with high-precision geospatial data.
  • Build APIs and services used across web, mobile, edge, and third-party applications, operating across cloud, on-premise, and intermittently connected environments.
  • Develop and optimise components of high-volume data processing pipelines handling point clouds, meshes, imagery, and other spatial data.
  • Collaborate with Computer Vision, machine learning, mobile, and geospatial teams.
  • Work with product managers and UX to translate customer problems into technical solutions.
  • Contribute to architecture, development standards, testing and observability.
  • Use modern AI-assisted development tools and AI agents for implementation, debugging, code review, security analysis, testing, and technical documentation.
  • Take ownership of features and systems from design through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

About You

  • 5+ years professional experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, React and Next.js.
  • Working experience with large datasets or computationally intensive data processing pipelines.
  • Experience designing scalable APIs, backend services, and production application architectures.
  • Experience with geospatial software, GIS, and 2D/3D data, such as point clouds, meshes, orthophotos, terrain, models, LiDAR.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, data structures, algorithms, performance optimisation, and automated testing.
  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Experience debugging, profiling and operating production applications, including logging, metrics and error monitoring.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, technical judgment and ownership, with the ability to work effectively on complex or ambiguous problems.
  • Fluency in Spanish and English.
  • Legally entitled to work in Mexico.

Highly Regarded Qualifications and Experience

  • Experience with WebGL, CesiumJS, or Three.js, including spatial data formats, projections, and coordinate systems.
  • Experience integrating Computer Vision, machine learning, or AI capabilities into production products.
  • Experience in mining, construction, autonomous systems, robotics, or other industrial environments.

About RPM

RPMGlobal is the mining industry’s leading enterprise technology and training provider and has been at the forefront of change and innovation in the mining industry for over 50 years.​​

We advance the mining industry towards a safer, more efficient, and more sustainable future through the delivery of innovative software solutions and deep domain mining expertise. Guided by our underlying principles of mining expertise, innovation, and sustainability, we strive to create safer and more efficient operations for our mining customers.

Our focus on providing advanced mining enterprise technology and training across the mining lifecycle enables us to guide customers through the industry's current and emerging challenges worldwide. This includes helping them meet the shift in social norms and consumer and investor ESG-related expectations.

Please, no agencies or recruiters.

Who we are:

MasterClass is the streaming platform where the world’s best come together so anyone, anywhere, can access and be inspired by their knowledge and stories. We put you in the room with the creators, thinkers, makers and leaders who have changed the world, so that you can change yours.

Design your career with Elaine Welteroth, get ready to win with Lewis Hamilton, perfect your pitch with Shonda Rhimes and discover your inner negotiator with Chris Voss.

We’re a remote-first workforce with collaborative work spaces in San Francisco and Kitchener, Ontario, and employees in several U.S. states. If you’re interested in joining a dynamic, culture-driving company—where learning invaluable skills is all in a day’s work—we invite you to apply.

We are looking for more than what a resume can show. If you don’t have the exact experience or skills, but think you’d be a great addition to MasterClass, please apply for the role.

✨ Snapshot of the Role:

MasterClass is looking for an Events Manager to own live events end to end, with an initial focus on MasterClass Executive, our cohort-based business education program. You’ll produce the weekly virtual sessions that anchor each cohort, intimate learner gatherings, and the multi-day in-person experience that serves as a high point of the program.

As MasterClass expands cohort-based programming across Executive, Certificates, and other products, you’ll also help build the operational foundation for a centralized Events function supporting live experiences across the business.

✨ What You Will Do:

  • Own end-to-end production of live virtual sessions for MasterClass Executive and Certificates, including scheduling, run of show, rehearsals, speaker prep, platform setup, moderation, Q&A, and real-time troubleshooting.
  • Plan and execute in-person experiences, from smaller dinners and gatherings to the multi-day MasterClass Executive cohort experience, including venues, production, AV, vendors, travel, and on-site execution.
  • Manage the overarching MasterClass events calendar, coordinating instructor and practitioner availability, programming needs, and learner time zones.
  • Serve as the primary logistics partner for instructors, guest practitioners, and their teams, ensuring every experience feels seamless from preparation through day-of execution.
  • Build scalable event operations, including run-of-show templates, production checklists, escalation paths, backup plans, and post-event workflows.
  • Own event budgets, vendors, contracts, and negotiations, making thoughtful tradeoffs across scope, quality, and cost.
  • Partner closely with Community, Marketing, Product, and channel leads to drive attendance and create a strong learner experience before, during, and after events.
  • Use event data, feedback, and AI-enabled tools to continuously improve programming and scale the Events function.

✨ About You (Requirements):

  • 6+ years of event management, production, or experiential programming experience across both recurring virtual events and multi-day in-person experiences.
  • Deep experience producing live virtual programming and the ability to troubleshoot calmly and resourcefully while an event is live.
  • Proven experience managing venues, vendors, AV, contracts, budgets, and on-site event execution.
  • Exceptional project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage a weekly programming cadence alongside larger event builds.
  • Strong communicator who is comfortable working directly with high-profile speakers, executives, talent, and their teams.
  • Comfortable using event technology, data, and emerging AI tools to improve operations and the learner experience.
  • Willing to travel for in-person events and flex working hours around live programming across time zones.

raw.description:
Description

CapsLock builds exceptional marketing solutions for large partners in the home improvement industry. We don’t just advertise our clients’ products or services - we build long-term marketing solutions within the context of permanent partnerships.

Our people are the backbone of everything we do and are our most valuable asset. Our business model demands top talent across the board, and we aim to create conditions that attract and retain the best individuals globally.

﻿Role Overview

We are expanding our Product team, and this role owns a slice of the internal product ecosystem our teams run the business on.

Your starting focus is the Media Buyer Automation Platform — the rules engine, pacing logic, spend controls, alerting, and workflow tooling that let a small team of buyers manage budgets that would otherwise require significantly more headcount. From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts. We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product.

This is a hands-on builder role rather than a coordination role. Your users are colleagues, the feedback loop is short, and your work shows up in CPA, ROAS, wasted spend, and hours returned to the team. You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Data, Media Buying, Creative, and Operations.

Responsibilities

﻿

﻿1. Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the end-to-end roadmap for the Media Buyer Automation Platform, including discovery, prioritization, specifications, delivery, adoption, and iteration.
  • Take on additional internal products as the portfolio grows, sequencing work across marketing automation, reporting and analytics, creative operations, cross-platform account management, and data reconciliation while maintaining focus on the core platform.

2. User Needs & Automation

  • Work closely with media buyers to understand their workflows and translate their operational needs into reliable automation for budget pacing, anomaly alerts, spend guardrails, bulk actions, and approval flows.
  • Identify manual processes that are consuming capacity across the business and evaluate whether they should be automated through internal development, external solutions, or left unchanged.

3. Product Development & Delivery

  • Write clear product specifications that engineers can build from, including edge cases, failure modes, rollback behavior, and a defined bar for completion.
  • Prototype ideas and build lightweight automations where this can accelerate alignment or address smaller workflow needs without relying on the engineering roadmap.

4. Adoption, Measurement & Collaboration

  • Drive product adoption through onboarding, enablement, documentation, and continuous feedback loops that ensure tools remain actively used and valuable.
  • Define and track meaningful product metrics, ensuring they are properly instrumented and visible, while partnering with Data on event taxonomy, attribution challenges, and measurement trade-offs.

5. Experimentation & Optimization

  • Run experiments and staged rollouts to validate changes, particularly for functionality that affects advertising spend, before deploying them across full budgets.
  • Continuously evaluate and iterate on products based on performance data, user feedback, and evolving business needs.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in Product Management, with 2+ years owning data-heavy or workflow-heavy products end-to-end.
  • Proven track record of building internal or B2B tools for colleagues and driving high adoption.
  • Skilled in KPI design, event taxonomy, dashboarding, and turning numbers into decisions.
  • Active use of AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, n8n, custom scripts) to build prototypes and automate workflows. (Examples will be requested).
  • Practical understanding of LLM limitations, probabilistic feature evaluation, and fallback logic.
  • Comfortable running multiple workstreams at once and making confident calls on what to ship first.
  • Strong track record of launching small, frequent releases rather than big-bang updates.
  • Excellent written/verbal English—creates clear specs, explicit trade-offs, and transparent status updates.
  • Experience collaborating effectively across global time zones.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with paid acquisition platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok), rules engines, budget pacing, or creative testing workflows.
  • Computer Science, Computer Engineering degree, or experience managing complex SaaS products with multi-platform API integrations.
  • Hands-on experience with A/B testing frameworks, feature flagging, or staged rollout systems for spend-affecting logic.

﻿Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

Paid Time Off

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

Ongoing Learning

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

Home Office

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

Physical Well-Being

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

Unlimited Sick Days

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

Medical Coverage

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

Co-Working Space

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

Fun Stuff

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

About Us:
Heyo is a dynamic and innovative full service agency that specializes in creating cutting-edge design and development. We're on a mission to revolutionize user experiences through intuitive and responsive web interfaces. Join our talented team of engineers, designers, and product managers to help us build the future of web.

Position Overview:
We're looking for a Product Manager to be the primary interface between our clients and the rest of the team. You'll own the product side of each engagement, from the first conversation about what a client needs through delivery of the finished feature. Most of our work starts at 0 and gets to 1, so you'll spend a lot of time turning fuzzy goals into concrete, buildable specs.

You won't be doing it alone. You'll work day to day with a Project Manager who owns timelines and delivery logistics, so you can stay focused on the what and the why. An Engineering Manager will back you up on technical feasibility and architecture decisions, and you'll build alongside our engineers and designers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary point of contact between clients and our design and engineering teams

  • Lead client conversations: gather requirements, align on goals, demo work in progress, and manage expectations when priorities compete

  • Write user stories, acceptance criteria, and product specs that engineers can build from without guesswork

  • Prioritize the backlog and guide trade-off decisions, partnering with your Project Manager on timelines and dependencies

  • Work closely with our engineers and designers to take features from 0 to 1

  • Spot product and technical risks early and work through them with the Engineering Manager and the team

  • Define and track product metrics so we can show clients what's working and recommend what to do next

Qualifications:

  • 2-4 years in product management or a related role

  • You've taken a product, or a major feature, from 0 to 1

  • Comfortable leading client conversations and translating technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders

  • Experience managing client expectations and juggling competing priorities

  • You use data to make decisions and can define the metrics that matter for a product

  • User focused, with enough technical fluency to weigh engineering trade-offs

  • Experience in agile environments with distributed teams

  • You make strong use of AI tooling in your day-to-day work

  • Proficiency with Linear (what we use) or Jira

  • Agency or consultancy experience is a plus, but not required

Heyo offers a variety of benefits, including:

  • Unlimited paid time off

  • Flexible schedule (make up your time for important personal, life, family events). We take work / life balance seriously!

  • 4 day client work weeks. We spend Friday's working on internal needs and personal betterment.

  • You'll get in trouble if we catch you working nights and weekends. For reals.

  • 1 week paid holiday rest at the end of the year. Over 3 weeks of company holidays throughout the year.

  • Health insurance coverage.

  • 401k Plan & matching.

  • Paid parental, adoption/caregiver leave.

  • Education & conference budget.

Everyone is welcome.
Heyo is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.Heyo is a tight knit team of individuals that love the work we do and more importantly, love the people we get to do it with. If a company who loves doing great work and focuses on people over profits sounds like the type of culture you're looking for, apply now!

Founded in 2004, NetBrain is the leader in no-code network automation. Its ground-breaking Next-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management. Today, over 2,500 of the world’s largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain’s platform.

What We Need

NetBrain is in a growth phase, and that includes the People Experience team. This is a newly created role designed to allow HR leadership and our Business Partners to focus on their specialty areas rather than carrying a broad operational scope.

We need a dedicated owner for the operational engine of People Experience, someone who can build and manage the systems, programs, and processes that keep HR running accurately and compliantly at scale. This includes owning HRIS, comp and merit cycles, lifecycle processes, compliance, and HR analytics, with benefits oversight as part of the portfolio.

If you are energized by building structure in ambiguous environments, have a strong command of HR systems and total rewards, and want to own the infrastructure that powers People Experience at a PE-backed tech company, this is the role for you!

Systems & Analytics

  • Own HRIS administration across our people systems (ATS, People Management, HRIS) ensuring data integrity, workflow efficiency, and system integrations are maintained
  • Lead data governance across people systems, clean data, accurate reporting, and a single source of truth for headcount and compensation
  • Continue to build and maintain our existing job architecture, leveling frameworks, job codes, and consistency across the org
  • Design and deliver people analytics dashboards for the Board, ELT, and People team, covering headcount, attrition, comp, and hiring metrics
  • Partner with the VP of People to build and manage HR/AI workflows to automate and streamline operational HR processes

Lifecycle & Compliance

  • Own end-to-end onboarding and offboarding, creating a consistent and welcoming experience for every new hire and a respectful, organized process for every departure
  • Manage US-federal compliance filings and training, including multi-state requirements and the annual global compliance calendar
  • Own the People inbox and HR communications, ensuring employees and managers get accurate, timely responses
  • Maintain and update HR policies as the company evolves in partnership with Legal

Total Rewards Administration

  • Administer compensation programs for global employees including Sales, managing comp changes, equity tracking, and cycle execution
  • Own bonus and merit-cycle administration from planning through payout, including data integrity and manager communications
  • Oversee the Benefits Partner who handles benefits administration, carrier relationships, open enrollment, leave administration, and employee questions
  • Manage equity tracking and administration in partnership with Legal & Finance
  • Build and run employee recognition programs that reinforce culture and performance with support from the People Business Partners

What You Bring

Required

  • 8+ years of progressive HR operations and/or total rewards experience with meaningful ownership of total reward programs
  • Hands-on HRIS and ATS administration experience; led RFP process and implementation for new HRIS vendor
  • Strong comp fundamentals: salary benchmarking, merit cycles, sales incentives, bonus administration, and internal equity
  • Experience building or maintaining job architecture and leveling frameworks
  • Federal and multi-state US compliance knowledge and you know what you don't know and when to escalate appropriately
  • Data-driven mindset; you build dashboards and reports people actually use
  • Comfort operating with high autonomy in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment
  • Located or able to work central or eastern time zone work hours.
  • SHRM-CP, PHR, or equivalent certification

Preferred

  • Experience in a mid-sized, high growth professional services or tech company
  • Exposure to global HR operations across US, India, Canada, UK, Germany, and China
  • Experience with AI tools or workflow automation in an HR context
  • Understanding of benefits management
  • Experience with ADP, Lattice, and Greenhouse
  • Experience with using Aon Radford

Our comprehensive compensation package is vital in how we recognize our people for the impact they make on us reaching our goals as a company.

For this role, the estimated base is $150,000 - $170,000 + Bonus. The actual salary may vary based on a range of factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process.

Industry: Interior Design / Professional Services
Compensation:$2,000 – $4,000 USD/month
English Proficiency:C1/C2 English Required
Schedule: Full-Time | Required overlap with U.S. business hours
Reports To: CFO


About the Company
Our client is a U.S.-based luxury interior design firm specializing in bespoke, high-end environments that combine exceptional design, craftsmanship, functionality, and personalized client service.
The company is strengthening its internal finance operations and is looking for an experienced accounting professional who can bring the same level of precision and attention to detail to its financial function.
About the Role
We are seeking an accomplished QuickBooks Financial Controller with deep, hands-on QuickBooks expertise to take ownership of the company's accounting operations.
Reporting directly to the CFO, you will have full responsibility for the General Ledger, lead the transition from an outside accounting firm to a fully in-house accounting function, manage monthly close and reconciliations, prepare financial reporting, and oversee the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable team.
QuickBooks expertise is essential for this position. This role requires more than day-to-day usage. You must be comfortable configuring and optimizing QuickBooks and have experience with QuickBooks implementations.
This is a hands-on position for someone who is highly accurate, independent, comfortable working in a fast-paced remote environment, and willing to support operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting when needed.
Why This Opportunity?
  • Take full ownership of the company's accounting operations and General Ledger.
  • Become the internal QuickBooks expert for the organization.
  • Work directly with the CFO and play a key role in strengthening the finance function.
  • Lead the transition from outsourced accounting to a fully in-house operation.
  • Manage and improve accounting processes, controls, and reporting.
  • Work remotely with significant autonomy and responsibility.
What You'll Do
QuickBooks & General Ledger
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks to support the company's accounting structure and reporting requirements.
  • Lead or support QuickBooks configuration and implementation initiatives.
  • Lead the transition of the General Ledger from an outside accounting firm to an in-house function.
  • Maintain, reconcile, and close the books monthly.
  • Establish and maintain the Chart of Accounts and appropriate classification standards.
Financial Reporting & Cash Management
  • Prepare accurate financial statements across the company's business divisions.
  • Prepare and review Profit & Loss (P&L) statements.
  • Oversee bank reconciliations.
  • Monitor the company's cash position.
  • Maintain accurate and reliable financial information for CFO review.
Team Leadership & Client Support
  • Supervise Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable specialists.
  • Review and approve invoices, hours reports, and client statements before distribution.
  • Review and approve payroll, vendor payments, and expense submissions.
  • Interface with clients regarding accounting-related requests when required.
  • Ensure accounting work completed by the team meets established standards.
  • Support operational and non-accounting matters that may arise within a small-team environment.
Tax & Accounting Controls
  • Coordinate payroll tax, sales tax, and 1099-related matters.
  • Execute accounting policies established by the CFO accurately and consistently.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a high standard of accuracy.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • Prior experience as a Financial Controller, Senior Accountant, or similar senior accounting professional with full ownership of the General Ledger.
  • Advanced, hands-on QuickBooks expertise.
  • Professional experience with QuickBooks Online and/or QuickBooks Desktop.
  • Experience configuring QuickBooks and/or leading a QuickBooks implementation.
  • Strong experience managing the General Ledger, reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Experience preparing financial statements and P&L reports.
  • Strong understanding of Chart of Accounts structures and accounting classifications.
  • Experience overseeing or working closely with Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
  • Strong attention to detail and consistently low error rates.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to execute accounting policies and procedures with precision.
  • Comfortable supporting operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting.
  • C1/C2 English proficiency, both written and spoken.
  • Ability to work with required overlap during U.S. business hours.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience transitioning an accounting function from an external accounting firm to an in-house team.
  • Experience with BigTime or similar project accounting software.
  • Previous experience in professional services, interior design, architecture, construction, or project-based businesses.
  • Experience supervising accounting or bookkeeping professionals.
How Success Is Measured
Success in this position will be measured by your ability to:
  • Maintain an accurate and reliable General Ledger.
  • Independently execute reconciliations and month-end close.
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks according to business requirements.
  • Successfully support the transition to an in-house accounting function.
  • Deliver accurate and timely financial reporting.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a consistently low error rate.
  • Effectively oversee AP and AR activities.
  • Work independently while executing CFO policies accurately.
  • Communicate professionally with U.S.-based colleagues and clients.
Video Presentation Required
As part of your application, please submit a short video in English introducing yourself and briefly summarizing your accounting background, followed by a 30-second to 1-minute overview of your QuickBooks experience, including how many years you have used it professionally, whether you have worked with QuickBooks Online and/or Desktop, your main responsibilities in the system, and any experience configuring QuickBooks or leading an implementation.
Why Join Us?
  • $2,000 – $4,000 USD/month, based on experience and location.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Direct exposure to the CFO and company leadership.
  • Significant ownership of the accounting function.
  • Opportunity to lead an important financial operations transition.
  • Long-term, full-time contractor opportunity.
  • Short initial trial period to ensure mutual fit.
Important Notes
Advanced QuickBooks expertise is a core requirement for this position. Basic familiarity, occasional use, or self-taught exposure without substantial professional experience will not be sufficient.
Candidates should be prepared to clearly explain their years of QuickBooks experience, versions used, responsibilities within the system, experience running monthly close, and any QuickBooks configuration or implementation experience.
C1/C2 English is mandatory. The role operates entirely in English with a U.S.-based team and, at times, directly with clients.
This is a permanent, full-time contractor opportunity with a short initial trial period.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

WHAT WE DO

Founded in 2007, Growth Acceleration Partners (GAP) is a premier consulting and technology services company built for the AI era. We consult, design, build, and modernize revenue-generating software and data engineering solutions. By leveraging AI-native architectures, advanced data analytics, and deep modernization strategies, we help businesses secure a competitive advantage.

GAP’s remote, integrated engineering teams deliver end-to-end solutions that drive true business innovation. We are a woman-owned, Austin-based company with over 600 English-speaking engineers across Latin America and the U.S. Boasting industry-leading customer satisfaction scores, our core focus is the dual success of our clients and our people. We are a values-based organization deeply invested in the growth of our "GAPsters"—providing continuous education, onsite English classes, and cutting-edge training in AI, machine learning, and next-gen technologies to ensure our communities achieve long-term success.

Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented Senior QA Engineer with specialized expertise in Power BI testing, Microsoft Fabric environments, and end-to-end data validation. In this role, you will define and execute a comprehensive testing strategy that validates data integrity from the Lakehouse and semantic model layers down to the front-end user interface. Combining rigorous manual validation, deep backend SQL checks, and DAX verification, you will bridge UI testing with source-to-visual reconciliation to ensure high performance and reliability across reporting ecosystems.

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance with a heavy focus on data-centric applications, Power BI reporting environments, and complex data validation

  • Hands-on experience performing Power BI report testing at the Lakehouse and semantic model layers (including data relationships and DAX expression validation)

  • Demonstrated expertise in source-to-visual data reconciliation using advanced SQL queries rather than relying solely on UI reviews

  • Solid foundation in QA fundamentals: writing structured test cases from user stories/requirements, defect lifecycle management, and conducting thorough root-cause investigations prior to escalating issues

  • Practical experience working in Microsoft Fabric or Azure ecosystems, handling data migrations, data pipeline verification, and environment parity comparisons

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute comprehensive QA strategies across data workflows, pipelines, and semantic models within Microsoft Fabric and Power BI environments

  • Perform Lakehouse and semantic model layer validation, verifying data relationships, measures, and DAX calculation accuracy

  • Conduct rigorous source-to-visual data reconciliation by writing complex SQL queries against backend data sources to confirm transformation accuracy

  • Lead front-end Power BI UI testing, validating report layouts, navigation, user permissions, and visual consistency

  • Derive testable requirements from user stories to create structured test cases with clear acceptance criteria

  • Document, track, and verify defects with precise reproduction steps, severity categorization, and supporting evidence across functional, regression, and UAT cycles

  • Compare legacy reporting systems against Microsoft Fabric environments to ensure functional parity and data alignment

  • Conduct root cause analysis for data anomalies and collaborate closely with Data Engineers and Developers to resolve quality bottlenecks

Required Technical Skills

Strong experience in several of the following areas:

  • Power BI & Semantic Testing: Deep hands-on experience with Power BI Service, Power BI UI testing, semantic model layers, data relationships, and DAX validation

  • Data Validation & SQL: Advanced SQL querying for backend data validation, source-to-visual reconciliation, and data pipeline verification

  • QA Fundamentals: Mastery of test case design, acceptance criteria definition, defect reporting, root-cause analysis, and distinguishing functional, regression, and UAT boundaries

  • Cloud & Data Environments: Practical experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure ecosystems, Lakehouse architectures, and advanced Excel for comparative analysis

  • Defect & Test Management: Experience utilizing Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar test management tools for defect tracking and test documentation

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on test automation experience using Playwright, Selenium, or similar UI automation frameworks

  • Knowledge of automated testing approaches for data integration pipelines and CI/CT practices

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted testing or coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) for data verification

  • Exposure to Azure security protocols, data governance frameworks, or large-scale data migrations to Microsoft Fabric

Soft Skills

  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)

  • Strong analytical mindset with a habit of investigating data anomalies deeply before escalating

  • Excellent documentation skills for creating clear, reproducible, and repeatable test cases and bug reports

  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work closely with Data Engineers, Developers, and Product Stakeholders

  • High attention to detail, organizational discipline, and technical ownership over data reliability

raw.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Senior Director of Power Origination to join our team.

Position Description

The Senior Director of Power Origination is Oklo's primary commercial dealmaker for power offtake. You will build and manage the customer pipeline for Aurora powerhouse projects — identifying, qualifying, negotiating, and executing power purchase agreements with AI datacenters, hyperscalers, utilities, industrial customers, and government buyers. You report to the VP of Origination and work in close coordination with the Directors of Land & Real Estate and Market Analytics, as well as Oklo's Finance team on project finance bankability.

Specific responsibilities may include:

Customer Pipeline & Business Development

  • Support Oklo's power offtake pipeline from initial outreach through signed PPA across all customer segments
  • Develop and execute origination strategy for AI datacenters, hyperscalers, C&I industrials, utilities, and federal/DoD buyers
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with power procurement leads at priority customers
  • Manage a structured CRM pipeline covering all active opportunities from first contact to executed agreement in partnership with Oklo’s Business Development team
  • Develop and maintain senior-level relationships with utility offtakers — including IOU power procurement executives, municipal utility resource planning leads, and electric cooperative CEOs — to build durable commercial pipelines for Aurora powerhouse output

PPA Negotiation & Execution

  • Lead negotiation of long-term PPAs, tolling agreements, and energy services contracts for Aurora powerhouse projects
  • Work closely with Legal to develop Oklo's standard PPA template, negotiate commercial terms, and manage contract execution
  • Structure offtake arrangements that are bankable for project finance — coordinating with Oklo's Finance team and lenders on required contract terms and credit support

Market Positioning

  • Partner with Director of Market Analytics on competitive pricing strategies and customer-specific value analyses
  • Develop customer-facing materials: pitch decks, term sheets, RFP responses, and technical briefings
  • Track competitive corporate PPA and utility offtake landscape, including bilateral nuclear deals and emerging clean firm power products

Utility Offtaker Relationships

  • Build and sustain a dedicated utility offtaker relationship program spanning investor-owned utilities (IOUs), public power authorities, electric cooperatives, and municipal utilities across Oklo’s target markets
  • Serve as Oklo’s senior point of contact for utility RFP processes, integrated resource planning (IRP) engagements, and state regulatory dockets where Aurora powerhouse supply is relevant
  • Negotiate and execute utility-scale PPAs and long-term supply agreements, coordinating with Legal and Oklo’s Finance team on regulatory approvals, FERC jurisdictional matters, and rate-base or cost-of-service considerations
  • Track utility load forecasts, resource adequacy filings, and clean energy procurement targets to identify and prioritize the highest-probability utility offtake opportunities across the Aurora powerhouse pipeline

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years in power origination, energy commercial development, or structured energy sales — with a direct track record closing long-term PPAs
  • Demonstrated experience selling to at least two of: AI datacenters / hyperscalers, C&I industrials, IOUs, or federal agencies
  • Deep familiarity with PPA structures, energy contract terms, and bankability requirements for project-financed generation assets
  • Strong negotiation skills; experience leading commercial discussions at C-suite and VP level
  • Ability to translate complex nuclear technology into clear commercial value propositions

Competencies

We are looking for a Senior Director of Power Origination that is:

  • Passionate about clean energy
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $225,000-$275,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

About Introhive

Introhive is an AI-powered Relationship Intelligence platform that helps firms break down data silos and unlock actionable relationship insights that drive collaboration and growth.

Since launching in 2012, we’ve grown significantly, but our mission remains the same: to transform how companies manage, nurture, and leverage relationships to unlock value, accelerate growth, and delight customers.

Introhive is one of the fastest-growing B2B relationship intelligence platforms. We’re recognized as a category leader in sales intelligence and data quality management software by G2, named a Top 10 Fastest Growing Technology Company in Deloitte’s Fast 50 Awards three years running, and awarded the 2020 MarTech Breakthrough Award for Best CRM Innovation.

Trusted by industry-leading brands including KPMG, Freshfields, CBRE, and Deloitte, Introhive supports more than 250,000 users across 90+ countries.

Location

Open to candidates located within Canada, preference given to those located in NB or NS.

Job Summary

Introhive is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our AI/ML team and help shape the next generation of our enterprise intelligence platform. You'll work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI capabilities and world-class software delivery, building the interfaces, APIs, and tooling that bring our AI-powered features to life. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment and love solving complex technical problems, we'd love to meet you.

Job Responsibilities

  • Extend our existing enterprise applications with new user interfaces and RESTful APIs that surface AI-powered capabilities to customers
  • Partner with ML engineers, UX designers, and product managers to translate complex model outputs and user requirements into elegant, production-ready features
  • Own features end to end, from database and API design through front-end implementation and deployment
  • Identify opportunities to optimize system architecture, performance, and scalability across the ML platform
  • Design and build internal tooling that enables teams to more effectively deploy, test, monitor, and operate ML models and pipelines
  • Champion engineering best practices including code reviews, testing strategies, documentation, and mentorship of junior engineers
  • Work with quality engineering to improve automated testing processes and application reliability
  • Contribute to technical roadmap discussions, helping translate business goals into sound architectural decisions
  • Work independently and collaboratively within the team

Qualifications

  • University degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience
  • Strong proficiency in at least one back-end language (Ruby/Rails experience is a plus; we also use Python)
  • Ability and desire to learn new languages and frameworks
  • Solid experience designing, building, and consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency with modern front-end frameworks (e.g. React, Vue, or Angular) and an understanding of front-end performance best practices
  • Strong SQL development skills and experience working with relational databases
  • Experience with source control tools like Git and modern branching, PR, and code review workflows
  • Experience or exposure to Agile development methodology

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to ML workflows, whether working alongside data scientists, integrating model APIs, or building ML-adjacent tooling
  • Familiarity with LLM-based systems and ML frameworks
  • Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Experience with cloud data warehousing and analytics engineering, particularly Snowflake and dbt
  • Experience working in cloud environments (AWS) and with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices

Why Introhive?

At Introhive, we believe people do their best work when they feel trusted, empowered, and supported. That’s why we value outcomes over hours, curiosity over perfection, and collaboration over ego. You'll have room to grow, tools to succeed, and a team that’s got your back.

Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit .

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE JOB
The Coordinator, Social Media supports the day-to-day execution of social publishing across Live Nation’s venues. Reporting to a Social Media Manager, this role is responsible for scheduling, posting, quality control, and content organization to ensure social channels operate efficiently and consistently.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Schedule and publish social content across assigned platforms.

  • Ensure accuracy of show information, dates, and ticket links.

  • Assist with content asset organization and management.

  • Monitor posts for performance and flag notable trends.

  • Support Managers with campaign rollouts and content updates.

  • Maintain platform hygiene and adherence to brand standards.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 1–3 years of experience in social media or digital marketing.

  • Familiarity with social publishing tools and analytics platforms.

  • Strong attention to detail.

  • Ability to work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

raw.excerpt: Sommaire du posteLe ou la rédacteur(trice) technique bilingue est responsable de la rédaction, de la traduction, de la révision et de la mise à jour de la documentation liée au logiciel ERP, en français et en anglais.
raw.description:
Sommaire du poste

Le ou la rédacteur(trice) technique bilingue est responsable de la rédaction, de la traduction, de la révision et de la mise à jour de la documentation liée au logiciel ERP, en français et en anglais. La personne participe à la production de guides utilisateurs, procédures, notes de mise à jour, de certains contenus de formation et libellés applicatifs, tout en veillant à la qualité linguistique, à la cohérence terminologique et à l’exactitude fonctionnelle des contenus.

Elle collabore étroitement avec l’équipe de développement, d’assurance qualité et d’implantation afin d’assurer la livraison d’une documentation claire, structurée et à jour.

Responsabilités principales

  • Rédiger, réviser, traduire, mettre à jour et structurer la documentation en français et en anglais.

  • Adapter la documentation existante, les procédures, les guides utilisateurs et les notes de mise à jour.

  • Traduire et réviser les libellés, les messages système et certains contenus de formation.

  • Assurer la cohérence terminologique au sein de l’application et de la documentation.

  • Collaborer avec les analystes, développeurs, équipe AQ et équipe d’implantation afin de valider l’exactitude du contenu des documents produits.

  • Effectuer des vérifications dans l’application pour s’assurer de la qualité, de la clarté et de la conformité des textes affichés à l’écran.

  • Identifier, documenter et signaler les anomalies de traduction, de libellés ou de documentation.

  • Effectuer les révisions linguistiques et intégrer les corrections reçues.

  • Préparer, organiser et publier les documents dans les répertoires ou plateformes internes appropriés.

  • Maintenir à jour les fichiers de suivi, les glossaires, les bases terminologiques et les documents d’avancement.

  • Participer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques, gabarits, outils et processus de rédaction et de traduction.

  • Fournir un soutien transversal en révision, traduction et validation linguistique à différentes équipes ou lignes de produits de l’organisation, selon les priorités d’affaires.

  • Apprendre à naviguer dans l’ERP et à en comprendre les principales fonctionnalités afin de produire une documentation claire, exacte et adaptée aux utilisateurs.

Poste à 100% Télétravail,

Tâches spécifiques pouvant être confiées

Produire, traduire et mettre à jour :

o guides utilisateurs;

o procédures internes;

o documentation de formation;

o notes de mise à jour;

o aide en ligne;

Effectuer le suivi de l’avancement des travaux de rédaction et de traduction.

Modifier la mise à jour d’images, de captures d’écran et de visuels liés à la documentation.

Participer aux échanges de validation avant publication.

Profil recherché

  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’écrit.

  • Capacité à vulgariser de l’information technique et fonctionnelle.

  • Très bonne aptitude à rédiger de façon claire, structurée et rigoureuse.

  • Souci du détail, de la qualité linguistique et de la cohérence.

  • Bonne capacité d’analyse, d’organisation et de gestion des priorités.

  • Autonomie, sens de l’initiative et esprit de collaboration.

  • Capacité à travailler avec plusieurs intervenants et à gérer plusieurs livrables simultanément.

  • Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement en développement continu, avec une approche pragmatique orientée vers les priorités et l’amélioration progressive.

  • Capacité à apprendre rapidement un environnement applicatif complexe et à en comprendre les processus afin de produire une documentation pertinente.

Exigences

  • Formation en rédaction, traduction, communication, langues, documentation technique ou domaine connexe.

  • Expérience en rédaction technique, traduction et gestion documentaire en environnement logiciel, dans un contexte bilingue français anglais.

  • Bonne connaissance de la suite Microsoft Office, particulièrement Word et Excel.

  • Expérience avec des outils de traduction ou de gestion terminologique, un atout.

  • Expérience de travail avec un ERP ou des applications d’affaires, un atout.

Atouts

  • Connaissance d’outils comme Trados Studio, Antidote, SharePoint, Teams, Visio ou autres outils documentaires.

  • Familiarité avec les processus de développement logiciel, d’assurance qualité et de publication documentaire.

*Seul les candidats retenus seront contactés.

Harris souscrit à un programme d’accès à l’égalité en emploi et les candidatures des membres des groupes visés à savoir les femmes, les personnes handicapées, les personnes autochtones et les minorités visibles sont encouragées à soumettre leur candidature. Si vous êtes une personne handicapée, vous pouvez recevoir, sur demande, de l’assistance pour le processus de présélection et de sélection.

L'équipe de recrutement de talents de Harris n'a pas recours aux messages texte pour entrer en communication avec les candidats ou solliciter des informations confidentielles. Nous encourageons tous les candidats à postuler sur des postes publiés. Ils seront contactés soit par un gestionnaire de Harris, soit par un membre de l'équipe de recrutement de talents pour un entretien, dès lors que les critères requis sont satisfaits.
